title.zh-TW: 自託管執行器支援保留閒置工作階段，遇唯讀倉儲限流自動略過啟動
title.en: Self-Hosted Runner Supports Keeping Idle Sessions and Skips Rate-Limited Read-Only Repositories on Startup

body.zh-TW:
你在自建伺服器上透過執行器跑自動化任務時，主機上常會還留著沒跑完的行程。⟦好比租用會議室開跨部門會議，以前只要投影機連線異常，整間會議室就直接被系統取消鎖死；現在會議室會先略過故障的投影機照常開門，若散會後還有討論小組在白板前整理紀錄，門禁也不會立刻熄燈鎖門。⟧

如果你使用 `self-hosted-runner` 執行任務，現在新增了 `--hold-idle-file` 與 `--max-hold-min` 兩個參數。當你的主機回報有先前留下、仍在執行的行程時，閒置的工作階段（session，指一段持續連線的互動過程）會被保留下來。

另外，過去在啟動階段若新增的唯讀倉儲遭遇速率限制，例如收到 HTTP 429 錯誤或 Git 包裝程式以代碼 75 退出，整個工作階段會直接啟動失敗。現在自託管執行器會自動略過受限的唯讀倉儲，讓主工作階段順利開啟。
body.en:
When running automation tasks via a runner on a self-hosted server, your host often still has unfinished processes left behind. ⟦Consider renting a conference room for a cross-departmental meeting: previously, whenever the projector connection glitched, the entire room was immediately cancelled and locked by the system; now, the room skips the faulty projector and opens as usual, and if a discussion group stays behind to organize notes at the whiteboard after the meeting ends, access control will not immediately turn off the lights and lock the doors.⟧

If you run tasks using `self-hosted-runner`, two new options, `--hold-idle-file` and `--max-hold-min`, are now available. When your host reports processes left running from earlier, an idle session (an ongoing interactive connection) is preserved.

In addition, when an added read-only repository encountered rate limiting during startup in the past—such as receiving an HTTP 429 error or a Git wrapper exiting with code 75—the entire session failed to start. Now, the self-hosted runner automatically skips the rate-limited read-only repository, allowing the main session to open smoothly.

items.original:
Added `--hold-idle-file` and `--max-hold-min` to `self-hosted-runner`, to keep an idle session while your host reports processes it left running
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a session failing to start when a rate limit (HTTP 429, or a git wrapper that exits 75) blocks an added read-only repository; it now starts without that repository

title.zh-TW: 終端機輸入 ultrathink 啟用極高思考力度，支援運算中動態拉高
title.en: Typing ultrathink in Terminal Enables Extra-High Thinking Effort with Dynamic Mid-Turn Boosts

body.zh-TW:
面對特別棘手的架構重構或演算法除錯，你可能會希望模型花費更多時間徹底深思。⟦就像開車上坡踩油門降檔，以前出發前設定巡航就不能改，遇到陡坡只能慢速爬；現在行進中踩踏板能立刻注入動力，儀表板增壓燈也只在真正出力時亮起。⟧

在互動終端機輸入 `ultrathink`，就能讓 Anthropic API 上的 Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5、Haiku 5.5 與 Fable 5.1 模型，以極高力度（xhigh effort）深層思考。即使 Claude 已開始回答，中途輸入 `ultrathink` 也能拉高該輪剩餘運算的思考深度。

彩虹文字特效也同步調整。彩色效果只在該關鍵字確實能拉高思考力度的位置出現；若是在引號內或檔案路徑中提及，介面將保持正常文字顏色。
body.en:
When facing particularly thorny architecture refactoring or algorithm debugging, you might want the model to spend more time thinking deeply. ⟦A driver climbing an uphill slope downshifts and steps on the gas: previously, the cruise control setting could not be altered once set before departure, leaving the car to crawl slowly on steep hills; now, pressing the pedal mid-drive instantly injects power, and the dashboard boost light illuminates only when actual extra power is being delivered.⟧

Typing `ultrathink` in the interactive terminal allows Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, and Fable 5.1 models on Anthropic's API to think deeply at extra-high effort (xhigh effort). Even if Claude has already started answering, typing `ultrathink` midway raises the thinking depth for the rest of that turn's computation.

The rainbow text effect has also been adjusted in tandem. The colorful effect appears only where the keyword can genuinely raise thinking effort; if mentioned inside quotes or as part of a file path, the interface keeps normal text color.

items.original:
Changed `ultrathink` in the interactive terminal to run its turn at xhigh effort on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 and Fable 5.1 through Anthropic's API; typed while Claude is working, it raises the rest of that turn
Changed the `ultrathink` rainbow to appear only where the keyword can raise effort, and not when the word is quoted or part of a file path

title.zh-TW: 思考力度提示快取未命中納入警告，用量清單完整揭露消耗
title.en: Prompt Cache Misses from Thinking Effort Add Warnings, Usage List Fully Reveals Consumption

body.zh-TW:
當你切換不同模型規劃工作或審查程式碼時，快取未命中可能在不知不覺中消耗寶貴額度。⟦如同水電帳單列出詳細明細，以前更換特殊家電造成的突發耗電全被隱藏，讓人摸不清額度花去哪裡；現在儀表會在切換不同規格設備時主動提示耗損，帳單也會印出大額開銷。⟧

在計劃模式下調整思考力度時，若計劃模型與當前工作階段的模型不同，`/effort` 指令現在會主動提醒提示快取（把重複內容暫存起來直接使用）未命中，讓你評估額外成本。

`/usage` 指令也補上了顯示，過去遺漏的大型提示快取未命中現在會如實列出。執行 `/code-review` 時，Claude 會優先考慮思考力度，只在明確要求時使用最高等級。此外，模型名稱移除了無實質效果的 `[1m]` 後綴，但仍相容該舊寫法。
body.en:
When switching between different models to plan tasks or review code, cache misses can consume valuable quota without you noticing. ⟦Utility bills that break down every detail offer a clear parallel: previously, sudden power spikes caused by swapping in specialized appliances were entirely hidden, leaving people wondering where their quota went; now, the meter proactively warns of power loss when switching to devices with different specifications, and the bill prints out large expenses.⟧

When adjusting thinking effort in plan mode, if the plan model differs from the current session model, the `/effort` command now proactively warns about a prompt cache miss so you can assess additional costs.

The `/usage` command has also updated its display, faithfully listing large prompt cache misses that were previously omitted. When running `/code-review`, Claude prioritizes thinking effort and uses the maximum level only when explicitly requested. In addition, model names have dropped the `[1m]` suffix where it had no practical effect, though the legacy format remains accepted.

items.original:
Fixed `/effort` not warning about a prompt cache miss in plan mode when the plan model differs from the session model
Fixed `/usage` never showing large prompt-cache misses under "What's contributing to your limits usage?"
Changed model names and IDs to drop the `[1m]` suffix and its label on models where the suffix has no effect; the suffix is still accepted
Changed `/code-review` to tell Claude to put the effort level first and use max only when asked

title.zh-TW: 對話突破二十萬記號自動壓縮，讀取記憶與摘要確認機制完善
title.en: Conversations Past 200K Tokens Auto-Compact, Memory Reading and Summary Checks Improved

body.zh-TW:
進行長篇對話或處理大型專案時，對話歷史累積過長容易觸發長度上限。⟦一如圖書館整理堆積如山的研究筆記，以前筆記寫滿固定頁數便直接拒絕翻頁，甚至還可能翻出已作廢的舊草稿；現在館員會主動將厚重資料裝訂濃縮後讓你繼續書寫，裝訂前還會重新檢查重點摘要有沒有確實寫上。⟧

在標準情境工作階段中，單次請求若超過 20 萬個 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位），以往工具會直接中斷並提示需要 1M 上下文點數。現在工具會主動壓縮對話歷史，替你整理脈絡後直接繼續執行，不再中途停擺。

這項自動壓縮機制也修正了檔案狀態讀取錯誤。如果工作階段稍早修改過 MEMORY.md 或 CLAUDE.md，先前在自動壓縮後模型會讀到未更新的舊版內容，這項問題已經修好。

此外，當模型產生的壓縮回覆遺漏了摘要內容時，工具會在替換現有對話前再次向模型索取摘要。
body.en:
During extended conversations or when working on large projects, lengthy conversation histories easily trigger context limits. ⟦Imagine a library organizing mountains of research notes: in the past, once notes filled a fixed number of pages, you were simply refused from turning the page, and obsolete drafts might even resurface; now, librarians proactively bind and condense bulky materials so you can keep writing, rechecking whether key summaries are properly included before binding.⟧

In standard-context sessions, when a single request exceeded 200,000 tokens (text units for AI processing and billing), the tool previously halted directly and prompted that "Usage credits required for 1M context". Now, the tool proactively compacts the conversation history, organizing context for you and continuing execution directly without stalling midway.

This automatic compaction mechanism also fixes a file state reading error. If MEMORY.md or CLAUDE.md was edited earlier in the session, the model previously saw stale, unupdated content right after automatic compaction; this issue has now been resolved.

Additionally, when the model's compaction reply misses summary content, the tool requests the summary once more from the model before replacing the existing conversation.

items.original:
Fixed standard-context sessions stopping with "Usage credits required for 1M context" when a request ran over 200K tokens; Claude Code now compacts the conversation and continues
Fixed Claude seeing stale MEMORY.md and CLAUDE.md content right after automatic compaction when those files were edited earlier in the session
Improved compaction: when the model's reply has no summary in it, Claude Code now usually asks for the summary once more before it replaces the conversation

title.zh-TW: 嚴格落實停用壓縮設定，回溯確認訊息修正為刪除後續紀錄
title.en: Disable Compaction Setting Strictly Enforced, Rewind Confirmation Clarifies Removing Later Messages

body.zh-TW:
有些團隊因為審計要求或排錯需求，必須完整保留每一步的對話原始脈絡。⟦好比法院審訊紀錄必須逐字存檔，以前即便交代全程錄影，部分書記官仍會自作主張節錄大意；現在只要掛上禁令牌，所有成員與選單都嚴格禁止濃縮文字，調閱紀錄時也會清楚告知是將後續筆記抽除。⟧

設定 `DISABLE_COMPACT` 環境變數時，代理隊友不再自動壓縮歷史紀錄。輸入 `/rewind` 呼叫回溯選單時，也不再提供「從此處摘要」或「摘要至此處」的選項。

設定檔與模組環境中的 `DISABLE_COMPACT` 現在只能關閉壓縮，不能反向重新開啟。執行 `/rewind` 時，確認畫面已修正為告知後續訊息會被移除，而非誤稱對話將被分叉；警告訊息也更正了手動與 Bash 編輯絕不受程式碼還原影響的說法。
body.en:
Some teams must preserve the original context of every conversation step due to audit requirements or troubleshooting needs. ⟦Courtroom trial records requiring verbatim archiving present an identical principle: previously, even when ordered to record proceedings entirely, some clerks would take it upon themselves to summarize main points; now, whenever a prohibition badge is placed, all members and menus are strictly barred from condensing text, and retrieving records clearly states that subsequent notes are being removed.⟧

When the `DISABLE_COMPACT` environment variable is set, agent teammates no longer automatically compact history. Entering `/rewind` to open the rewind menu also no longer offers "Summarize from here" or "Summarize up to here" options.

`DISABLE_COMPACT` in configuration files and module environments can now only turn compaction off, not re-enable it. When running `/rewind`, the confirmation screen has been corrected to state that subsequent messages will be removed, rather than incorrectly claiming the conversation "will be forked"; the warning message has also corrected the claim that manual and Bash edits are never affected by a code restore.

items.original:
Fixed agent teammates compacting their history when `DISABLE_COMPACT` is set
Fixed the rewind menu offering "Summarize from here" and "Summarize up to here" when `DISABLE_COMPACT` is set
Fixed the /rewind confirmation saying the conversation "will be forked" when the later messages are removed from the conversation
Fixed the /rewind warning that wrongly said manual and Bash edits are never affected by a code restore
Changed `DISABLE_COMPACT` in settings files and in a mod's `$.env.set` so they can only turn compaction off, not back on

title.zh-TW: 子代理支援動態連線外部工具，修復重複觸發掛鉤與資源清除
title.en: Subagents Support Connecting Tools Dynamically, Fixing Repeated Hook Triggers and Cleanup

body.zh-TW:
讓主代理拆分子任務到背景平行執行時，背景代理往往需要獨立的目錄與工具支援。⟦宛如派遣專案小組到獨立會議室作業，以前只要協調人提早離席，會議室白板就會被清空，門口打卡鐘每分鐘還狂響兩次；現在支援工具稍晚送達也能順利接收，小組未完工前會議室絕不提前清空。⟧

子代理啟動後，若遇到連線較慢的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，連線完成後已能正常使用其工具。

子代理使用的隔離工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能），不再於背景子代理仍在工作時被提早刪除。`SubagentStop` 掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）改為結束時才觸發一次，不再每分鐘重複兩次。背景代理等待終端機喚醒時不再誤開新輪次；雲端或背景工作階段重啟時，已完成的技能也不再重複執行。
body.en:
When the main agent breaks subtasks down into background parallel execution, background agents often require dedicated directories and tool support. ⟦Dispatching a project task force to an independent meeting room mirrors this setup: previously, if the coordinator stepped out early, the whiteboard was wiped clean, while the punch clock by the door rang twice every minute; now, support tools arriving late are properly received, and the room is never cleared out early before the team finishes work.⟧

After a subagent starts, if it encounters an MCP (Model Context Protocol, an open standard connecting AI to external tools) server that takes longer to connect, it can now properly use those tools once connection completes.

An isolated worktree (Git's mechanism to run multiple parallel copies of the same project) used by a subagent is no longer deleted prematurely while a background subagent is still working in it. `SubagentStop` hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) now fire only once upon completion instead of repeating twice a minute. Background agents waiting for terminal wakeups no longer mistakenly start a new main conversation turn. When cloud or background sessions restart, completed skills no longer run a second time.

items.original:
Fixed subagents being unable to use MCP tools from servers that finish connecting after the subagent starts
Fixed `SubagentStop` hooks running about twice a minute for each running subagent instead of once when it finishes
Fixed a subagent's isolated worktree being removed while a background subagent it started was still working in it
Fixed background agents in auto mode that wait on their own shells starting a new main conversation turn on every wake
Fixed a finished `/code-review`, or another skill that runs in a sub-agent, running a second time when a cloud or background session restarts

title.zh-TW: 代理團隊恢復保留任務清單，輸入快捷鍵對齊離開行為
title.en: Agent Teams Retain Task Lists on Reconnection, Keybinding Aligns Exit Behavior

body.zh-TW:
使用多代理團隊協同作業時，中斷後重新連線往往依賴系統完整保留待辦事項。⟦跟專案團隊在白板前排程一樣，以前午休回辦公室重新召集時，白板上的待辦工作便條全被擦拭一空，甚至還把新分支的進度貼回舊看板；現在重新進場白板依然完整，交談時也不會重複遞交相同的便條。⟧

在代理團隊工作階段中，使用 `--resume`、`--continue`、`/resume` 或 `--session-id` 重新連線，或是 `/clear` 與當機重啟後，工作清單不再被清空。執行 `/branch` 分支時，也不再誤把進度寫入原始工作階段的清單。

在個別代理交談分頁中，若有訊息等待發送，按方向鍵 ↑ 改為正常的歷史紀錄呼叫，不再重複送出訊息。在代理檢視畫面中，輸入框為空時連按兩次 Ctrl+D 即可退出，與主要提示列行為一致。
body.en:
When collaborating with multi-agent teams, reconnecting after interruptions relies on the system completely preserving pending tasks. ⟦Scheduling around a whiteboard with a project team illustrates the problem: previously, when reconvening in the office after lunch, all task sticky notes on the whiteboard were wiped clean, and progress from a new branch was even pasted back onto the old board; now, the whiteboard remains intact upon returning, and identical notes are not repeatedly handed over during conversations.⟧

In agent team sessions, reconnecting via `--resume`, `--continue`, `/resume`, or `--session-id`, as well as running `/clear` or recovering from a crash, no longer empties the task list. Running `/branch` also no longer mistakenly writes progress to the original session's list.

In an individual agent's chat tab, pressing the up arrow key ↑ when a message is waiting to be sent now properly recalls history rather than sending a duplicate message. In agent view, pressing Ctrl+D twice on an empty input now exits, matching the behavior of the main prompt.

items.original:
Fixed ↑ in an agent's chat tab recalling a message that was still waiting to be delivered, so resending it sent a second copy
Fixed agent teams sessions showing an empty task list when coming back with `--resume`, `--continue`, `/resume` or `--session-id`, including after `/clear` or a crash, and `/branch` writing to the original session's list
Changed Ctrl+D in agent view to match the prompt: on an empty input, pressing it twice exits

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制連線阻擋即時回報，雲端協作工具重啟不遺失
title.en: Remote Control Promptly Reports Blocked Connections, Cloud Collaboration Retains Tools Across Restarts

body.zh-TW:
當你人在外面透過手機或遠端終端機連回電腦工作時，連線穩定度與訊息歸屬至關重要。⟦猶如利用衛星電話遠端指揮基地營運作，以前遇到中繼線路阻擋時訊號會卡在連線中無聲乾等數分鐘，助理代發的公文還會被蓋上你本人的私章；現在線路受阻會立刻回報，附件超量或磁碟已滿也會說明原因，重啟系統後裝備依然完好。⟧

遠端控制若被網路 Proxy 阻擋，不再卡在 Connecting 兩分鐘。手機版中 Claude 發給雲端或遠端工作階段的訊息，不再誤標為你發送。

附件因磁碟滿或超過 20 個被略過時會提示原因。Cowork 雲端工作階段抓取與搜尋卡住改為 300 秒逾時；重啟不再因指定 `agent` 遺失工具。使用 `/teleport` 或 `claude --teleport` 載入已壓縮工作階段時，會提示本地不含摘要前訊息。
body.en:
When working remotely from a mobile phone or terminal outside the office, connection reliability and message attribution are critical. ⟦Directing base camp operations remotely over a satellite phone follows the same pattern: previously, whenever a relay line was blocked, the signal stalled silently on connecting for several minutes, while dispatches sent by an assistant were stamped with your personal seal; now, blocked lines are reported immediately, full disks or excess attachments explain their causes, and equipment remains intact after restarting the system.⟧

If Remote Control is blocked by a network proxy, it no longer stays on "Connecting" for two minutes. In mobile apps, messages that Claude sends to a cloud or Remote Control session are no longer mistakenly attributed to you.

When attachments are omitted because the disk is full or exceed 20 files, the system now explains the reason. In Cowork cloud sessions, hanging fetching and searching now time out after 300 seconds; restarts no longer lose tools due to specifying an `agent`. Loading a compacted session via `/teleport` or `claude --teleport` now warns that local copies omit messages prior to summarization.

items.original:
Fixed Remote Control sessions staying on "Connecting" for about two minutes when a network proxy blocks a startup request
Fixed messages that Claude sends to a cloud or Remote Control session appearing as your own message in the Claude mobile apps
Fixed Claude not being told the cause when a file attached to a message sent over Remote Control or to a cloud session could not be saved because the disk was full, or that a message's attachments past the first 20 were left out
Fixed WebFetch and WebSearch hanging on a stalled response in Cowork cloud sessions; an unfinished request now fails after 300 seconds
Fixed Cowork cloud sessions losing their connectors and most tools after a restart when a plugin or your settings named an `agent`; Cowork cloud sessions now ignore that setting
Improved `/teleport` and `claude --teleport` to warn when a compacted cloud session loads from its last compaction, so the messages it summarized aren't in the local copy

title.zh-TW: 背景守護服務支援排程崩潰重啟，指引與重生指令精準回報
title.en: Background Daemon Restarts Scheduled Sessions on Crash, Accurately Guiding Recovery and Respawn

body.zh-TW:
把繁重任務丟給背景服務處理時，最怕背景行程突然無聲無息終止。⟦就像大樓夜班巡邏系統異常，以前中控台建議按下的開關是早已拆除的舊按鈕，即使查無紀錄仍先盲目啟動發電機；現在設有定時巡邏的異常中斷會自動重啟，系統也會給出明確的重新接班指引。⟧

背景工作階段處於釘選、連線中，或設有排程任務與喚醒時，若在輪次間崩潰，現在會自動重啟。

背景服務無回應時，錯誤提示改為建議執行 `claude daemon stop --any` 並說明會終止所有背景工作階段，不再建議已停用的指令。執行 `claude respawn <id>` 時，會先檢查該識別碼是否存在，避免找不到工作階段卻白白啟動背景服務。

背景行程結束時的訊息不再給予無法兌現的重啟承諾，並說明如何恢復工作階段。從支援超連結的終端機開啟背景工作階段時，狀態列（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）連結現在能正常點擊。
body.en:
When delegating heavy workloads to background services, sudden silent terminations of background processes are a major concern. ⟦Night watch patrol systems in a commercial high-rise face a comparable scenario: previously, the control console advised flipping a switch that had long been removed, blindly spinning up generators even when no records were found; now, abnormal interruptions during scheduled patrols trigger automatic restarts, and the system offers clear guidance on resuming shift duties.⟧

When a background session is pinned, connected, or has scheduled tasks or wake-ups configured, it now automatically restarts if it crashes between turns.

When the background service does not respond, the error prompt now suggests running `claude daemon stop --any` and explains that it terminates all background sessions, rather than recommending a disabled command. Running `claude respawn <id>` now checks whether that ID exists beforehand, preventing the background service from launching needlessly when no matching session is found.

Messages shown when a background process exits no longer promise an impossible restart and explain how to resume the session. When opening a background session from a terminal supporting hyperlinks, status line (the bar displayed at the bottom of the terminal) links can now be clicked normally.

items.original:
Fixed a background session that crashed between turns not being restarted while it was attached, pinned, or had a scheduled task or wake-up set
Fixed the "background service did not respond" error suggesting the disabled `claude daemon restart`; it now suggests `claude daemon stop --any` and says it ends background sessions
Fixed `claude respawn <id>` starting the background service before reporting that no background session matches the id
Fixed status line links staying plain text in background sessions after you open them from a terminal that supports links
Improved the messages shown when a background session's process exits: they no longer promise a restart that isn't coming, and they say how to resume the session

title.zh-TW: MCP 專案路徑精確對應，清除認證與遠端狀態顯示修復
title.en: MCP Accurately Maps Project Paths, Fixing Cleared Auth and Remote Status Displays

body.zh-TW:
管理各專案外接的自訂工具時，設定檔存放路徑與連線狀態標示若失準會增加除錯負擔。⟦好比辦公大樓的訪客門禁系統，以前在分部登記設備時系統會把子隔間誤當成獨立公司，免換證的會議室在重設門禁卡後還被誤亮紅燈；現在設定路徑皆正確溯源至所屬專案，通行證核發狀態也如實標示。⟧

在倉儲子目錄執行 `claude mcp add`、`claude mcp remove` 或 `/mcp` 時，設定會對應到 `~/.claude.json` 中的專案項目，不再誤指向當前子目錄。

`claude mcp list` 與 `claude mcp get` 連線失敗時不再重複印出錯誤碼。在 `/mcp` 中，免登入的遠端 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器清除認證後不再誤報失敗；未發送憑證的遠端伺服器也不再誤報已通過認證。
body.en:
When managing external custom tools across projects, inaccurate configuration paths and connection states increase debugging overhead. ⟦Visitor access control in an office tower operates under the same reality: previously, registering equipment in a branch caused the system to mistake a sub-cubicle for an independent enterprise, and meeting rooms requiring no badges were erroneously flagged with red lights after keycard resets; now, configuration paths trace back accurately to their parent projects, and pass issuance statuses are faithfully displayed.⟧

When running `claude mcp add`, `claude mcp remove`, or `/mcp` in a repository subdirectory, settings map to the project entry in `~/.claude.json` rather than incorrectly pointing to the current subdirectory.

`claude mcp list` and `claude mcp get` no longer print duplicate error codes when connections fail. In `/mcp`, a remote MCP (Model Context Protocol, an open standard connecting AI to external tools) server that requires no sign-in no longer reports failure after "Clear authentication". A remote server to which no credentials were sent also no longer falsely shows "authenticated".

items.original:
Fixed `claude mcp add`, `claude mcp remove` and `/mcp` naming the current folder instead of the project entry in `~/.claude.json` that holds a local-scope server when run below a repository root
Fixed `claude mcp list` and `claude mcp get` showing the error code twice on failed-connection lines (for example `ENOENT: ENOENT: …`)
Fixed `/mcp` showing a remote server as failed after "Clear authentication" when the server works without sign-in
Fixed `/mcp` showing "authenticated" for a remote server that Claude Code sends no credentials to

title.zh-TW: 中斷指令遇下載即時生效，外掛目錄識別與技能快取優化
title.en: Interrupting Claude Takes Effect Immediately During Downloads, Plugin Directory Recognition and Skill Caching Optimized

body.zh-TW:
請模型抓取外部資料或載入擴充外掛時，反應停頓或目錄誤判會打亂開發節奏。⟦一如圖書館借閱多冊參考書，以前只要其中一本在運送中，按下取消借閱就必須等到運送逾時才能離開櫃檯，把整箱書籍歸還時還會被當成同一冊登記；現在取消操作能即刻停止等待，十分鐘內查過的書單也能直接調閱。⟧

當外部工具伺服器未回應資源讀取或技能仍在下載時，按下中斷鍵現在會即時生效，不再等到連線逾時。

使用 `--plugin-dir` 指定包含多個外掛的資料夾時，若頂層含有空的 `.mcp.json`，不再誤載為單一外掛。此外，設定 `CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS` 且未啟用功能旗標抓取的工作階段，現在會直接重複使用本機其他工作階段在 10 分鐘內取得的 claude.ai 技能清單，省去頻繁重新查詢的時間。
body.en:
When asking the model to fetch external data or load extension plugins, unresponsive pauses or misidentified directories disrupt development rhythm. ⟦Like borrowing multiple reference books from a library, pressing cancel used to force you to wait at the counter until delivery timed out if just one book was in transit, and returning a box of books was even logged as a single volume; now canceling stops the wait immediately, and book lists checked within ten minutes can be retrieved directly.⟧

When an external tool server has not answered a resource read or a skill is still downloading, pressing interrupt now takes effect immediately instead of waiting for a connection timeout.

When using `--plugin-dir` to specify a folder containing multiple plugins, an empty `.mcp.json` at the top level is no longer mistakenly loaded as a single plugin. In addition, sessions that set `CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS` with feature-flag fetching off now directly reuse a claude.ai skills list fetched by another session on the machine within 10 minutes, saving the time of frequent re-queries.

items.original:
Fixed interrupting Claude not taking effect until a timeout while an MCP server had not answered a resource read or a skill was still downloading
Fixed a `--plugin-dir` folder of plugins loading as one plugin when an empty `.mcp.json` was at its top
Changed sessions that set `CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS` with feature-flag fetching off to reuse a claude.ai skills list up to 10 minutes old that another session on the machine fetched

title.zh-TW: 檔案巨量改動不再停頓虛報，超長清單與比對預覽修復
title.en: Massive File Changes No Longer Stall or Underreport, Ultra-Long Lists and Diff Preview Fixed

body.zh-TW:
當專案中的設定規格繁複或單次修改涉及數千行時，檔案編輯工具的渲染效率直接影響操作流暢度。⟦如同文字編輯器校對超長卷軸，以前遇到連續排版的長條目整台機器就會卡死數秒，一次替換上千處文字後統計甚至荒謬地顯示為零；現在翻閱寬版卷軸不會算錯行數，沒有文字異動時也不會突然彈出比對視窗。⟧

在單一檔案中修改數千行時，Write 與 Edit 工具不再卡頓長達 5 秒或誤報變更了 0 行。CLAUDE.md 含有極長清單條目時，啟動與讀寫檔案後的長時間凍結問題已修復。

Write 工具在預覽寬度超出終端機的行時，不再跳行與算錯隱藏行數。在全螢幕寬終端機中，編輯後若無內容需要比對，比對面板不再自動彈出。
body.en:
When project configuration specifications are complex or a single edit touches thousands of lines, the rendering efficiency of file editing tools directly impacts workflow fluidity. ⟦Picture a text editor proofreading an ultra-long scroll: encountering continuous, lengthy entries used to freeze the entire machine for seconds, and statistics would even absurdly show zero after replacing thousands of lines of text at once; now flipping through a wide scroll does not miscount lines, nor does a comparison window suddenly pop up when there are no text changes.⟧

When modifying thousands of lines in a single file, the Write and Edit tools no longer stall for up to 5 seconds or falsely report that 0 lines changed. Long freezes at startup and after reading or writing files when CLAUDE.md holds an extremely long list item have been fixed.

When previewing lines wider than the terminal, the Write tool no longer skips rows or miscounts hidden lines. In fullscreen-width terminals, the diff pane no longer pops up automatically after an edit if there is nothing to compare.

items.original:
Fixed long freezes at startup and after reading or editing files when a CLAUDE.md file holds a very long list item
Fixed Write and Edit stalling for up to 5 seconds after they ran, and reporting 0 lines changed, when changing thousands of lines in a file
Fixed the Write tool's file preview skipping rows and miscounting hidden lines when a line is wider than the terminal
Fixed the diff pane opening by itself after an edit in wide fullscreen terminals when it had nothing to show

title.zh-TW: Shell 指令逾時保留部分輸出，沙盒衝突與環境描述修正
title.en: Shell Command Timeouts Retain Partial Output, Sandbox Conflicts and Environment Descriptions Corrected

body.zh-TW:
在命令列執行耗時的建置工作或背景腳本時，指令的執行狀態與權限邊界是判斷進度的依據。⟦宛如在安全防護室內操作長耗時機具，以前只要計時器一響，工作台上的半成品就會整盤收走不留紀錄，門口的警報器每天上班還對著老員工複誦同一套守則；現在時間到了會保留已加工的零件，防護室路徑重疊時也不會卡死。⟧

Shell 指令達到逾時上限時，結果會保留顯示迄今的輸出，並說明命令仍在背景執行。

Linux 下當 `--plugin-dir` 同時為加入的目錄且開啟阻擋讀取工作目錄外部檔案時，沙盒工具 `bwrap` 無法建立檔案的錯誤已解決。Bash 工具描述不再聲稱工作目錄在呼叫間永久保留，環境區塊不再標註未執行的 Shell（例如用 zsh 卻標出 fish）。設定檔權限規則警告改為每位使用者只顯示一次，直到規則變更。
body.en:
When running time-consuming build tasks or background scripts on the command line, command execution status and permission boundaries serve as the basis for judging progress. ⟦Operating long-running machinery inside a security containment room used to mean that once the timer rang, unfinished parts on the workbench were cleared away without a trace, and the alarm at the door repeated the exact same rules to veteran workers every single morning; now parts already machined are kept when time is up, and overlapping containment room paths no longer cause deadlocks.⟧

When a shell command reaches its timeout limit, the result now retains and displays the output so far, and states that the command is still running in the background.

On Linux, the error where the sandbox tool `bwrap` failed to create files when `--plugin-dir` was also an added directory and blocking reads outside working directories was enabled has been resolved. The Bash tool description no longer claims that the working directory permanently persists between calls, and the environment block no longer names an unexecuted shell (such as labeling fish when using zsh). Warnings for settings file permission rules are now shown once per user until the rule changes.

items.original:
Fixed the Bash tool description claiming the working directory always persists between calls
Fixed the environment block naming a shell commands don't run in, such as fish when the Bash tool uses zsh
Linux: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing with `bwrap: Can't create file` when a `--plugin-dir` folder was also an added directory and `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` was on
Improved shell commands that reach their timeout: the result now shows the output so far and says the command is still running in the background
Changed startup warnings about permission rules in settings files to show once per user until the rule changes

title.zh-TW: 產物支援依錨點路由多重視圖，智能劃分頁面與文件型態
title.en: Artifacts Support Routing Multiple Views by Anchor, Smart Distinction Between Page and Document Types

body.zh-TW:
請 Claude 製作互動展示或撰寫長篇報告時，產物的呈現形式直接影響閱讀與分享體驗。⟦比照設計公司交付專案成品，以前不管是互動原型還是正式合約，全用同一種資料夾交付，切換章節時網址標籤也不會跳轉；現在互動圖表會被製作成可點擊操作的展示網頁，長文文字則整理成方便傳閱修訂的文件。⟧

產物工具改進了成果型態的判斷邏輯。當你需要解說性文字、視覺圖表或具備按鈕等互動功能的作品時，Claude 會將其生成為獨立的產物頁面（page）。如果是適合團隊持續修訂、日常傳閱的純文字內容，則會建立為產物文件（document）。

如果單一產物中設計了多個切換視圖，現在系統會根據連結末端的 `#name` 錨點來精確路由至對應畫面。

這項視圖切換機制也修正了解釋說法。過去 Claude 在引導讀者切換不同檢視畫面時，會誤稱瀏覽器網址列保持不變，現在這段說明已更新為正確的路由行為。
body.en:
When asking Claude to build interactive demos or write lengthy reports, the presentation format of artifacts directly affects the reading and sharing experience. ⟦Much like a design agency delivering project deliverables, interactive prototypes and formal contracts used to be handed over in the exact same binder without URL hashes jumping when switching chapters; now interactive diagrams are crafted into clickable presentation web pages, while long-form prose is organized into documents easy to circulate and revise.⟧

The Artifact tool improved its logic for choosing output types. When you need explainer text, visual diagrams, or interactive creations with buttons, Claude generates them as standalone artifact pages. Plain text content suited for continuous team revisions and everyday circulation is created as artifact documents.

If multiple switchable views are designed within a single artifact, the system now routes precisely to the corresponding view based on the `#name` anchor at the end of the link.

This view-switching mechanism also corrects its explanation. In the past, when guiding readers through different views, Claude mistakenly stated that the browser address bar stayed the same, and this explanation has now been updated to reflect the correct routing behavior.

items.original:
Improved artifacts with several views: Claude now routes each view on the link's `#name` and no longer says the address bar stays the same as you switch views
Improved the Artifact tool's choice between a page and a document: explainers and visual or interactive work become artifact pages; documents are for writing people keep editing or pass around

title.zh-TW: 修正編輯器外掛虛假安裝提示，螢幕報讀回饋與問題清單簡化
title.en: False Editor Plugin Installation Notices Fixed, Screen Reader Feedback and Question Lists Simplified

body.zh-TW:
使用輔助工具或命令列設定開發環境時，操作狀態的真實反饋是避免誤判的前提。⟦猶如到服務櫃檯申請設備與無障礙語音導覽，以前安裝手續還在轉圈或中途失敗，系統就直接亮綠燈宣稱安裝成功，語音廣播裡甚至充斥著視覺用的箭頭符號；現在安裝失敗會如實回報，語音模式下取消的表單也不會被櫃檯誤收。⟧

在 `/ide` 安裝擴充套件時，不再於 VS Code 尚未裝完或失敗時回報已安裝，JetBrains 未安裝時也不再誤報成功。

螢幕報讀模式下，審查計劃時若按 Esc 放棄輸入回饋，不再誤送取消的文字。在 `/permissions` 刪除規則時，語音會即時提示已刪除允許規則。向使用者提問時，問題清單改為簡潔文字呈現，去除箭頭與符號。
body.en:
When using assistive tools or the command line to configure a development environment, accurate feedback on operation status is essential to prevent misjudgment. ⟦Think of applying for equipment and an accessible audio guide at a service counter: the system used to flash green and announce a successful installation while setup was still spinning or had already failed, and audio broadcasts were even cluttered with visual arrow symbols; now failed installations are reported truthfully, and forms dismissed under voice mode are no longer mistakenly collected by the counter.⟧

When installing extensions in `/ide`, it no longer reports that the VS Code extension was installed before the installation finishes or when it fails, nor does it falsely report success when JetBrains is not installed.

In screen reader mode, pressing Esc to dismiss feedback while reviewing a plan no longer mistakenly sends the cancelled text. When deleting a rule in `/permissions`, speech immediately announces that the allow rule was deleted. When asking the user questions, the question list is now presented in concise text, removing arrows and symbols.

items.original:
Fixed `/ide` saying the VS Code extension was installed before the install finished or when it failed
Fixed `/ide` saying it had installed the JetBrains plugin when nothing was installed
Fixed plan approval in screen reader mode sending feedback you had dismissed with Escape
Improved screen reader mode: deleting a rule in /permissions says "Deleted allow rule …" right away
Improved screen reader mode: Claude's questions are listed as "Questions: Color (answered), Pages", without arrows or symbols

title.zh-TW: 訂閱受限精準指引帳單設定，快取網路驗證加速工具啟動
title.en: Billing Settings Guidance for Restricted Subscriptions, Cached Network Verification Speeds Tool Startup

body.zh-TW:
每天頻繁啟動命令列工具時，每次開啟等待數秒的網路驗證會累積出明顯的時間成本。⟦跟持會員卡走進商務中心一樣，以前只要距離上次進門不到一小時，閘門仍要連上遠端主機反覆核對兩次身分，扣款卡關時櫃檯還叫個人會員去問根本不存在的公司主管；現在短時間內出入能快速通關，通行碼失效時也會提醒重抽號碼牌。⟧

Pro 與 Max 帳號在距上次檢查一小時內啟動，會自動跳過兩次網路請求以加速啟動。僅帶有選項與參數值的啟動（例如 `claude --model opus`）流程也經過優化。

Pro 與 Max 用戶無法使用訂閱時，提示訊息改為引導至帳單設定，不再誤叫用戶詢問管理員。貼上的登入碼被拒絕時，提示文字現在會說明代碼可能已過期或已使用，並提示重新登入。
body.en:
When launching command-line tools frequently throughout the day, waiting several seconds for network verification on every startup adds up to noticeable overhead. ⟦Entering a business lounge with a membership card used to mean that even if less than an hour had passed since your last entry, the turnstile still pinged a remote server to verify identity twice, and when payment failed the desk told individual members to ask a non-existent company manager; now entering within a short window grants fast clearance, and an expired pass triggers a reminder to draw a new ticket.⟧

Launches for Pro and Max accounts within an hour of the last check automatically skip two network requests to accelerate startup. Startup workflows for launches whose only arguments are options and their values (such as `claude --model opus`) have also been optimized.

When Pro and Max subscribers cannot use their subscription, the prompt message now guides them to billing settings instead of mistakenly telling them to ask an admin. When a pasted sign-in code is refused, the message now explains that the code may have expired or been used, and prompts them to sign in again.

items.original:
Fixed Claude Pro and Max subscribers being told to ask their admin when their subscription can't be used; the message now points to billing settings
Improved startup time for Pro and Max accounts by skipping two network requests on launches within an hour of the last check
Improved startup time for launches whose only arguments are options and their values, such as `claude --model opus`
Improved the message shown when a pasted sign-in code is refused: it now says the code may have expired or been used, and to sign in again

title.zh-TW: 雲端平台深層思考防閒置中斷，遵循不重試標記避免卡住
title.en: Deep Thinking on Cloud Platforms Protected from Idle Disconnection, Non-Retry Flags Respected to Prevent Hangs

body.zh-TW:
在企業級雲端環境調用外部模型時，複雜的網路代理與長時間運算常面臨連線挑戰。⟦如同長途車隊行經跨國公路，以前遇上需要精細核算的貨物，檢查站常因等待過久誤判車輛拋錨，對已被海關拒絕通行的貨物還反覆重新排隊；現在持續運轉的訊號能被正確識別，連線中斷時也會指出該優先檢查哪一個收費閘門。⟧

在 Google Vertex AI、Microsoft Foundry 與 AWS 平台上，端點會發送思考進度，不再被誤判閒置中斷。

API 標記不可重試時不再重試請求，避免對話卡住或無限重試。Anthropic API 連線中斷時優先提示檢查 Proxy 或閘道，其次為 VPN 或防火牆。Bedrock、Mantle、Vertex 與 Foundry 改由官方簽章檔載入設定，可設 `CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL_CATALOG=off` 關閉。
body.en:
When invoking external models in enterprise cloud environments, complex network proxies and long computations often pose connection challenges. ⟦Watching a long-distance convoy navigate a cross-border highway, checkpoints used to assume trucks had broken down whenever cargo required detailed audits, repeatedly requeueing freight already denied customs clearance; now active running signals are properly recognized, and connection drops point out which toll gate should be inspected first.⟧

On Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry, and AWS platforms, endpoints send thinking progress updates, so they are no longer misjudged as idle and cut off.

Requests are no longer retried when the API marks them not to retry, preventing conversations from stalling or retrying indefinitely. When the Anthropic API connection drops, the error first suggests checking the proxy or gateway, followed by the VPN or firewall. Bedrock, Mantle, Vertex, and Foundry now load model settings from an official signed file, which can be disabled by setting `CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL_CATALOG=off`.

items.original:
Fixed long hidden thinking being cut off as idle on Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS, where the endpoint sends thinking progress updates
Fixed Claude Code retrying requests the API marked not to retry, which could hold a turn for minutes or, in unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`), indefinitely
Improved the "Connection dropped" API error: it now says where to look first (the proxy or gateway in use, else VPN or firewall; Anthropic API only, Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged)
Changed Claude Code on Bedrock, Mantle, Vertex, and Foundry to load model settings from a signed file on downloads.claude.ai; set CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL_CATALOG=off to turn this off

title.zh-TW: 修正反斜線丟失與圖片路徑誤貼，檔案選取支援反向排除規則
title.en: Lost Backslashes and Pasted Image Paths Fixed, File Picker Supports Negation Rules

body.zh-TW:
在終端機中輸入指令、貼上文字或選取檔案時，文字被介面誤吞會打斷操作思維。⟦好比使用打字機整理手冊，以前貼上圖片路徑時打字機會自作主張剪掉路徑貼上照片，打出括號還會漏印反斜線，甚至在索引裡翻不到例外加註的文件；現在文字原貌完整保留，滑鼠在捲軸按錯時移開也能直接取消。⟧

回覆中引號或括號內的單獨反斜線（如 `"\"` 或 `(\)`）不再消失。貼上包含圖片路徑的文字（如 `! open /tmp/shot.png`）時，不再誤附加圖片並丟失路徑文字。

輸入 `@` 選取檔案時，現已支援 `.ignore` 與 `.rgignore` 的反向排除規則，能正確選取重新納入的檔案。輸入框已有文字時，回饋草稿卡片不再顯示快捷鍵以防按鍵衝突。全螢幕清單中的捲軸點擊改為放開滑鼠時才觸發，移開即可取消。
body.en:
When typing commands, pasting text, or selecting files in the terminal, having characters swallowed by the interface interrupts your train of thought. ⟦Organizing a manual on a typewriter used to mean that pasting an image path caused the typewriter to impulsively clip the text and paste a photograph, print brackets while omitting backslashes, or even fail to locate files noted as exceptions in the index; now original text is preserved intact, and misclicks on a scrollbar can be cancelled simply by moving away.⟧

A lone backslash inside quotes or brackets, like `"\"` or `(\)`, no longer disappears from replies. When pasting text containing an image path, such as `! open /tmp/shot.png`, it no longer mistakenly attaches the image and drops the path text.

When typing `@` to select files, negation rules in `.ignore` and `.rgignore` are now supported, correctly selecting re-included files. While the prompt contains text, the feedback draft card no longer displays shortcut keys to prevent key conflicts. Clicks on scrollbars in fullscreen lists now trigger only upon releasing the mouse button, allowing you to cancel by moving away.

items.original:
Fixed the @ file picker ignoring `.ignore`/`.rgignore` negation rules that re-include git-ignored files
Fixed pasting text that mentions an image file, such as `! open /tmp/shot.png` or `/review look at /tmp/shot.png`, attaching the image and dropping its path from the prompt
Fixed the feedback draft card showing its 1/2/0 and Esc shortcuts while the prompt has text, when those keys act on the prompt instead of the card
Fixed a lone backslash in quotes or brackets, like `"\"` or `(\)`, disappearing from Claude's responses
Changed clicks on scrollbar arrows and bars in fullscreen lists to act when the mouse button is released, so moving off the scrollbar before letting go cancels the click

title.zh-TW: SDK 歷史紀錄依序留存，JSON 控制字元轉義與發文檢查
title.en: SDK Transcripts Preserved in Order, JSON Control Character Escaping and Post Checks

body.zh-TW:
串接自動化腳本或整合通訊軟體時，資料格式的嚴謹度決定了下游服務能否正常解析。⟦宛如公文收發室分發函件，以前遇到特殊格式印章容易在系統建檔時出錯，自動派件員在轉發公文時也常略過門口貼著的公告；現在特殊字元均按標準代碼轉義封裝，派送前也會先閱讀該單位的收件守則。⟧

`claude -p` 與 SDK 工作階段保存記錄時訊息順序錯亂或保留已撤回訊息的問題已修復。索取解說時會顯示說明型輸出風格的操作提示。

`--output-format json` 與 `stream-json` 會將字串內的 DEL、C1 控制字元與 Unicode 格式字元寫為 `\uXXXX` 轉義格式。向未指名的 Slack 頻道發訊前，Claude 現在會先檢查該頻道主題的發布規則。此外，`claude purge` 說明已載明僅刪除本機資料，不影響 Anthropic 儲存的內容。
body.en:
When connecting automation scripts or integrating messaging software, data format rigor determines whether downstream services can parse correctly. ⟦Handling mail dispatch in a registry office, special seal stamps used to cause errors during system filing, and automated messengers forwarding documents frequently ignored notices posted right at the doorway; now special characters are escaped and packaged using standard codes, and the recipient's intake guidelines are reviewed before delivery.⟧

Issues where `claude -p` and SDK sessions saved transcript messages out of order or retained retracted messages have been resolved. A tip for the Explanatory output style is now displayed when asking for explanations.

`--output-format json` and `stream-json` now write DEL, C1 control characters, and Unicode format characters inside strings as `\uXXXX` escape formats. Before messaging an unnamed Slack channel, Claude now checks that channel's topic for posting rules. In addition, the explanation for `claude purge` clarifies that it deletes data only on this machine, without affecting anything stored by Anthropic.

items.original:
Added a tip for the Explanatory output style, shown when you ask Claude for explanations
Fixed `claude -p` and SDK sessions saving transcript messages out of order or keeping messages that were taken back
Improved Slack connector sends: Claude now checks a channel's topic for posting rules before messaging a channel you didn't name
Changed `--output-format json` and `stream-json` output to write DEL, C1 control and Unicode format characters inside strings as `\uXXXX` escapes; parsed values are unchanged
Changed `claude purge` to say it deletes data only on this computer, not anything stored by Anthropic

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 回覆程式碼支援語法上色，依編輯器設定停用遙測
title.en: [VSCode] Code in Replies Supports Syntax Coloring, Telemetry Disabled via Editor Setting

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 編輯器內與 AI 對話時，清楚的語法標示與靈敏的側邊欄能讓閱讀更舒適。⟦一如裝潢現代化程式工作室，以前對話面板裡的程式碼像是一張黑白影印紙難以辨認，工作室一開門還急著把倉庫所有遠端檔案整批載入；現在代碼全部換上彩色列印，側邊清單只在拉開抽屜時載入，門口也完全尊重隱私標示。⟧

VS Code 擴充套件中，Claude 回覆的程式碼區塊現已支援淺色、深色與高對比深色主題的語法上色。

側邊欄的工作階段清單改為在首次開啟 Web 分頁時才載入 Web 工作階段，不再於啟動時載入。當 VS Code 遙測關閉時，擴充套件會以 `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` 啟動 Claude Code，不發送用量指標、錯誤回報或抓取功能旗標。針對執行緩慢的 UserPromptSubmit 掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），新增了轉圈狀態與螢幕報讀提示。
body.en:
When chatting with AI inside the VS Code editor, clear syntax highlights and a responsive sidebar make reading much more comfortable. ⟦Renovating a modern coding studio used to leave code in the dialogue panel looking like an illegible black-and-white photocopy, and opening the front door immediately triggered a rush to bulk-load every remote file from storage; now code is fully printed in color, the sidebar list loads only when a drawer is opened, and privacy signs at the entrance are fully respected.⟧

In the VS Code extension, code blocks in Claude's replies now support syntax coloring across light, dark, and high-contrast dark themes.

The session list in the sidebar now loads Web sessions only when the Web tab is opened for the first time, rather than at startup. When VS Code telemetry is turned off, the extension launches Claude Code with `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`, sending no usage metrics or error reports and fetching no feature flags. For slow-running UserPromptSubmit hooks (small programs triggered by specific events), a spinner status and screen reader announcement have been added.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added syntax coloring to code blocks in Claude's replies, in light, dark and high contrast dark themes
[VSCode] Added a "Running UserPromptSubmit hooks" spinner status and screen reader announcement for slow UserPromptSubmit hooks
[VSCode] Changed the extension to start Claude Code sessions with `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` set while VS Code's telemetry setting is off, so they send no usage metrics or error reports and fetch no feature flags
[VSCode] Changed the session list side bar to load Web sessions when the Web tab is first opened, not at startup

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 自訂技能補齊當前檔案內容，修正登入凍結與點圖誤開
title.en: [VSCode] Custom skills include current file context, fixing login freezes and image click misbehavior

body.zh-TW:
直接在整合開發環境的側邊欄調用指令時，編輯器中的游標位置與選取範圍是用戶最自然的上下文。⟦猶如讓助理站在辦公桌前協同改稿，以前只要點選特別委託按鈕，助理就會漏掉你手指按著的段落，聽寫時按下遞交鍵錄音筆還持續開著；現在自訂委託能準確讀取當前視野，點擊圖片附件也不會莫名展開背後的文件。⟧

從 VS Code 或 JetBrains 面板送出自訂技能與自訂斜線命令時，過去遺漏開啟中檔案或選取行數的問題已修復，現在會如同一般訊息完整帶入。

macOS 與 Linux 上登入 Shell 讀取啟動檔 PATH 造成擴充套件主行程凍結的問題已修復。點擊工具結果中的圖片或關閉預覽時，不再誤於編輯器分頁開啟結果文字。使用傳送按鈕送出訊息時會先停止語音聽寫，避免持續錄音。
body.en:
When invoking commands directly from an IDE sidebar, the editor's cursor position and selected range serve as the user's most natural context. ⟦Standing with an assistant over a shared draft, clicking a custom delegation button previously caused the assistant to ignore the paragraph under your finger, and pressing the send key during dictation left the recorder running; now custom delegations read the active view accurately, and clicking image attachments no longer opens the underlying document unexpectedly.⟧

When sending custom skills and custom slash commands from the VS Code or JetBrains panel, a bug where open files or selected lines were left out has been fixed, and they are now included just like ordinary messages.

An issue where the login shell reading start-up files for PATH on macOS and Linux caused the extension host to freeze has been resolved. Clicking an image in a tool result or closing its preview no longer mistakenly opens the result's text in an editor tab. Sending a message with the Send button now stops voice dictation first to prevent ongoing recording.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed custom skills and custom slash commands sent from the VS Code or JetBrains panel leaving out the open file or selected lines that ordinary messages include (anthropics/claude-code#102799)
[VSCode] Fixed the extension host freezing while the login shell ran its start-up files to read PATH on macOS and Linux
[VSCode] Fixed clicking an image in a tool result, or closing its preview, also opening the result's text in an editor tab
[VSCode] Fixed voice dictation continuing to record after a message was sent with the Send button; sending now stops dictation first, as pressing Enter already did

title.zh-TW: [Cloud sessions] 雲端例行工作重返解鎖，環境設定杜絕重複名稱
title.en: [Cloud sessions] Cloud routines can be turned back on after owner rejoin, environment dialogs prevent duplicate names

body.zh-TW:
在雲端託管環境中排定自動化排程時，組織成員異動不應成為自動化工作永久鎖死的阻礙。⟦比照租用共享雲端機房的自動化排程，以前管理員短暫離職再重返職位後，先前設定的排程機台仍被強制鎖死，嘗試重製金鑰失敗時面板也毫無反應；現在重返團隊能重新啟用機台，設備命名時系統也會攔截重複標籤。⟧

在 Anthropic 託管環境中，自動化例行工作的擁有者退出組織又重新加入後，該例行工作不再卡在鎖定狀態，擁有者現在可以重新將其啟用。

當例行工作的 API 權杖（授權令牌）刪除或重新產生失敗時，即使編輯對話框已關閉，畫面現在也會跳出錯誤通知。雲端環境對話框（含管理員對話框）不再接受重複名稱，會主動拒絕清單中已有的名稱。
body.en:
When scheduling automated tasks in a cloud-hosted environment, organizational member turnover should not permanently lock automated workflows. ⟦Renting automated slots in a shared server room, a manager temporarily leaving and later rejoining the company previously left earlier scheduled machines permanently locked, and failed key regenerations gave no feedback on the console; now returning to the team allows machines to be re-enabled, and naming equipment triggers checks that intercept duplicate tags.⟧

In Anthropic-hosted environments, when the owner of an automated routine leaves the organization and rejoins, the routine no longer remains locked, and the owner can now turn it back on.

When deleting or regenerating a routine's API token (authorization token) fails, the screen now displays an error toast even if the edit dialog has already closed. Cloud environment dialogs, including the admin dialog, no longer accept duplicate names and actively refuse names already used in the list.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Fixed routines in Anthropic-hosted environments staying locked after their owner left the organization and rejoined; the owner can now turn them back on
[Cloud sessions] Fixed a failed routine API token delete or regenerate showing nothing if the edit dialog had already closed; it now shows an error toast
[Cloud sessions] Fixed cloud environment dialogs, including the admin dialog, accepting duplicate names; they now refuse a name another listed environment already has

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] 新增 Slack 技能分析視圖，無報告內容安靜退出
title.en: [Claude Tag] Added Slack skills view to analytics, empty runs exit cleanly

body.zh-TW:
把 AI 標籤引入團隊通訊軟體協同工作時，清楚了解各項技能的調用頻率有助於優化工作流。⟦跟企業在內部群組引進數位布告欄一樣，以前無人知曉哪些功能受到員工歡迎，例行巡邏沒有狀況時看板還會發一張無事廢紙洗版；現在後台能檢視各工具的調用率，沒事時安靜收工，私密群組也會以鎖頭標識。⟧

Claude Tag 分析後台新增技能檢視畫面，能顯示 Claude 在 Slack 頻道中執行各項掛載技能的頻率與未使用的技能，管理設定中也提供用量連結。

在全新工作階段執行的例行檢查任務，若沒有值得報告的內容，現在會直接結束，不再向頻道發布廢棄訊息。管理員設定清單中，你帳號可見的私人 Slack 頻道改以鎖頭圖示取代原本的 `#` 符號。
body.en:
When bringing AI tagging into team messaging apps for collaboration, understanding invocation frequency across skills helps optimize workflows. ⟦Introducing a digital bulletin board to an internal company channel, teams previously had no visibility into which features employees actually used, and routine checks with nothing to report posted useless blank notices that cluttered the feed; now administrators can review invocation rates for each tool, quiet runs exit without posting, and private rooms display a lock badge.⟧

Claude Tag analytics has added a Skills view showing how often Claude runs each attached skill in Slack channels and which go unused, with Usage links provided in admin settings.

Routine inspection tasks that run in a new session can now end directly without posting a throwaway message to the channel if there is nothing to report. In admin settings, private Slack channels visible to your account now show a lock icon instead of the `#` symbol.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added a Skills view to Claude Tag analytics showing how often Claude runs each attached skill in Slack channels and which go unused, with Usage links in admin settings
[Claude Tag] Improved Claude Tag routines that run in a new session: a run with nothing to report can now end without posting a throwaway message to the channel
[Claude Tag] Changed Claude Tag admin settings to show a lock instead of # for private Slack channels that your own Slack account can see

title.zh-TW: [Code Review] 審查遇伺服器暫態故障自動重試，重試失敗明確收尾
title.en: [Code Review] Automatic retry on transient server faults, clear closure when retries fail

body.zh-TW:
在程式碼合併請求中依賴自動化機器人審核時，偶發的雲端連線抖動可能導致檢查流程卡住。⟦就像線上交卷系統送出報告一樣，以前遇到伺服器網路短暫瞬斷系統就直接判定繳交失敗，讓人不知該乾等還是手動重送；現在遇到線路故障會自動重連一次並清楚標示，若確定無法解析也會明確通知停止等待。⟧

因暫態伺服器故障而啟動失敗的程式碼審查工作階段，現在會自動重試一次，並在檢查執行（check run）中明確標示正在重試。

若模型在自動重試時依然無法分析變更，檢查執行會清楚說明不會再啟動後續的自動審查，避免團隊不知情地持續等待。
body.en:
When relying on automated review bots during pull requests, occasional cloud connection hiccups can stall the inspection process. ⟦Submitting assignments through an online portal, brief network drops previously led the system to immediately register a failed submission, leaving students uncertain whether to keep waiting or retry manually; now line faults trigger one automatic reconnect with clear status updates, and a failure to parse the material triggers a definitive notice to stop waiting.⟧

Code review sessions that fail to start due to transient server faults are now retried once automatically, and the check run clearly indicates that a retry is in progress.

If the model still cannot analyze a change during the automatic retry, the check run explicitly states that no further automatic review will start, preventing teams from waiting indefinitely without updates.

items.original:
[Code Review] Improved Code Review's check run to say no further automatic review will start when the model still can't analyze a change on the automatic retry
[Code Review] Improved Code Review reliability: a review whose session fails to start because of a transient server fault is now retried once automatically, and its check run says so

entries: Added the Monitor tool and plugin monitors on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry or nonessential traffic is disabled; long foreground sleeps are now blocked there too
Fixed requests failing behind some gateways and compatible servers that reject the `effort-2025-11-24` beta value or mid-conversation system messages; Claude Code now retries without them
Fixed background cleanup deleting some recent files, such as pasted images, when `cleanupPeriodDays` is set to a very large value
Fixed compaction after a "Prompt is too long" error keeping too much of a conversation with dense text, such as base64 or SVG, so the next request could fail again
Fixed file read permission prompts not showing where a symbolic link leads
Fixed a question's auto-continue timeout firing the moment the external editor closed after a long edit
Windows: Fixed PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks letting a tool call through when Git Bash is missing and the hook's command is only quoted strings, such as a quoted path
Improved auto mode's prompt before the first read outside the working directories: it now says when blocking those reads makes shell commands ask for permission
Improved memory use of non-interactive sessions (`-p`, Agent SDK) during compaction when the transcript file is very large
Improved a mod's `Image` to draw inside tmux with `allow-passthrough` and `focus-events` on, in kitty, Ghostty, and iTerm2 3.5+ with fullscreen rendering, where it showed only its `alt` text
Linux: Improved `/sandbox` and the sandbox startup warning to name Ubuntu's AppArmor restriction on user namespaces, and how to lift it, when it keeps bubblewrap from starting the sandbox
Changed the error for an MCP tool call that times out in a non-interactive session while the server's elicitation is unanswered: it now tells Claude that no answer came and not to repeat the call
[VSCode] Fixed pressing Enter on the plan review card's "Send feedback and keep planning" button approving the plan instead of sending your comments back
[VSCode] Fixed the panel showing "Something went wrong" after "Switch branch & continue" on a cloud session opened from Session history's Web tab
[Cloud sessions] Added Claude Code cloud sessions and Remote Control permissions to Enterprise custom roles, so Owners can control access to each by role
[Cloud sessions] Added a Choose file button to load a cloud environment's setup script from a file
[Cloud sessions] Fixed failed saves and archives in the cloud environment edit dialog showing no error inside the dialog
[Cloud sessions] Fixed failed routine API token actions showing only a toast; the error now appears in the routine edit dialog
[Cloud sessions] Improved the session start checklist to show a cloud environment's setup script output in a scrolling box
[Cloud sessions] Changed turning on Cloud sessions or Remote Control in admin settings to ask for confirmation and list the custom roles that have that permission
[Cloud sessions] Changed the cloud environment dialog to open network access, setup script and environment variables from rows instead of listing every editor at once
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag treating `!` commands such as `!restart` and `!help` as ordinary messages when sent in bold, italic or strikethrough
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag admin channel and workspace pages being replaced by a load error when a background refresh of the bundle list fails
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings reporting that no channels match a filter while channel names are still loading
[Code Review] Fixed the Code Review admin section hiding its repositories and switches after a failed refresh of the repository list
[Code Review] Improved the Code Review admin section to retry the first load and show one Try again banner when it still fails

title.zh-TW: Bedrock、Vertex 與 Foundry 支援監控工具，並阻擋前景長時等待
title.en: Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry Support the Monitor Tool and Block Long Foreground Waits

body.zh-TW: 透過 Bedrock、Vertex 或 Foundry 使用 Claude Code，或關閉遙測或非必要網路流量時，現在也能使用監控工具（Monitor tool，用來追蹤背景任務進度的小工具）與外掛監控功能。在上述情況下，如果程式發出長時間的前景暫停等待，也會被直接阻擋，避免終端機長時間卡在等待畫面。⟦走進實驗室，以前進度儀表板無法啟用，遇到長耗時工作只能原地乾等；現在能查看儀表板掌握背景工作狀態，也會攔下讓人原地久候的等待安排。⟧當你請 Claude 執行多步驟資料轉換，並將工作丟到背景執行時，就能透過監控工具掌握外掛與任務狀態，不必擔心前景指令無休止地休眠空轉。
body.en: When using Claude Code through Bedrock, Vertex, or Foundry, or when telemetry or nonessential network traffic is disabled, you can now use the Monitor tool (a utility for tracking the progress of background tasks) alongside plugin monitoring features. In these scenarios, if a program issues a long foreground pause wait, it is also directly blocked to prevent the terminal from being stuck on a waiting screen for extended periods. ⟦Step into a laboratory: previously, the progress dashboard could not be enabled, leaving you waiting idly during lengthy tasks; now you can check the dashboard to track background work, and arrangements that keep you waiting idly are intercepted.⟧ When you ask Claude to run a multi-step data transformation and send the work to the background, you can track plugin and task status through the Monitor tool without worrying about foreground commands sleeping indefinitely.

items.original: Added the Monitor tool and plugin monitors on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry or nonessential traffic is disabled; long foreground sleeps are now blocked there too

title.zh-TW: 連線網關拒收特定測試參數時，自動移除並重試請求
title.en: Automatically Stripping Rejected Beta Parameters and Retrying Requests Behind Gateways

body.zh-TW: 透過特定代理伺服器或自訂網關連線時，部分相容伺服器會拒收 effort-2025-11-24 測試參數，或不允許在對話中途加入系統訊息。以前這類請求會直接宣告失敗並中斷操作。現在遇到這種錯誤時，Claude Code 會自動去除不被接受的參數與中途訊息並重新發送請求，讓你在企業網關後方也能順暢發問。
body.en: When connecting through certain proxy servers or custom gateways, some compatible servers reject the effort-2025-11-24 beta parameter or disallow adding system messages in the middle of a conversation. Previously, such requests would directly fail and interrupt the operation. Now when encountering this error, Claude Code automatically strips the unaccepted parameter and mid-conversation messages before retrying the request, allowing you to prompt smoothly even from behind corporate gateways.

items.original: Fixed requests failing behind some gateways and compatible servers that reject the `effort-2025-11-24` beta value or mid-conversation system messages; Claude Code now retries without them

title.zh-TW: 清理週期設為極大值時，不再誤刪貼上的圖片等近期檔案
title.en: Setting the Cleanup Period to a Very Large Value No Longer Mistakenly Deletes Recent Files Like Pasted Images

body.zh-TW: 當你為了保留歷史紀錄而刻意把暫存清理天數 cleanupPeriodDays 設得非常大時，背景清理機制以前存在邏輯瑕疵，反而會把剛貼到對話中的圖片等近期檔案誤刪。這個問題現在已經修好。即使清理週期設得再長，Claude Code 也不會再提早清除這些近期剛建立的重要檔案。
body.en: When you intentionally set the temporary cleanup day count cleanupPeriodDays to a very large value to preserve history, the background cleanup mechanism previously had a logic flaw that mistakenly deleted recent files, such as images just pasted into the conversation. This issue is now fixed. Even when the cleanup period is set arbitrarily long, Claude Code will no longer prematurely purge these recently created important files.

items.original: Fixed background cleanup deleting some recent files, such as pasted images, when `cleanupPeriodDays` is set to a very large value

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮精簡密集文字，並改善龐大逐字稿的記憶體用量
title.en: Compacting Conversations Trims Dense Text and Improves Memory Usage for Huge Transcripts

body.zh-TW: 遇到提示詞超出上限（Prompt is too long）的錯誤後，壓縮對話仍可能留下太多內容，讓下一次請求再次失敗。這項壓縮處理（compaction，把落落長的前文摘要簡化）能釋放空間。以前面對含有 base64 編碼字串或 SVG 圖形等密集文字時，壓縮過程會保留過多原始內容，導致剛縮完的下一次請求仍可能報錯失敗，這個問題已經修好。⟦整理超重的行李箱時，以前收拾過後仍留下太多東西，再過磅還是可能超標；現在修好的，就是整理後仍保留過多內容的問題。⟧逐字稿檔案非常龐大時，改善非互動工作階段在壓縮期間的記憶體用量，例如加上 -p 參數或透過 Agent SDK 呼叫的工作階段。
body.en: After encountering an error where the prompt exceeds the limit ("Prompt is too long"), compressing the conversation could still leave behind too much content, causing the subsequent request to fail again. This compaction process (summarizing and streamlining lengthy earlier context) frees up space. Previously, when dealing with dense text containing base64-encoded strings or SVG graphics, the compaction process retained too much original content, causing the next request immediately after shrinking to still fail with an error; this issue is now fixed. ⟦Picture packing an overweight suitcase: previously, too much remained even after tidying up, so it could still exceed the weight limit on the scale; what has now been fixed is the issue of keeping too much content after tidying.⟧ When transcript files are very large, memory usage during compaction has been improved for non-interactive sessions, such as sessions with the -p parameter or those called via the Agent SDK.

items.original:
Fixed compaction after a "Prompt is too long" error keeping too much of a conversation with dense text, such as base64 or SVG, so the next request could fail again
Improved memory use of non-interactive sessions (`-p`, Agent SDK) during compaction when the transcript file is very large

title.zh-TW: 權限提示明列符號連結目標，並補強掛鉤檢查與外部讀取說明
title.en: Permission Prompts Explicitly List Symlink Targets, Strengthening Hook Checks and External Read Details

body.zh-TW: 審核工具存取權限或執行外部操作時，清楚的提示資訊能協助你做出正確判斷。當 Claude 請求讀取符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）時，提示視窗以前只顯示捷徑名稱，現在會直接標明它指向的實際目標。在 Windows 系統中，如果未安裝 Git Bash 且掛鉤指令只包含帶引號的字串，例如帶引號的路徑，PreToolUse 與 PermissionRequest 掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）以前會錯誤放行工具呼叫，這項問題已經修好。在 auto 模式首次讀取工作目錄外部前，提示會說明，在什麼情況下封鎖這些讀取，會讓後續終端機指令要求權限。以前你可能看不清捷徑去向或摸不透權限連鎖反應，現在每項提示都交代清楚，掛鉤也能確實把關。
body.en: When reviewing tool access permissions or executing external operations, clear prompt details help you make the right call. When Claude requests to read a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location), the prompt window previously showed only the shortcut name, but now directly indicates the actual target it points to. On Windows systems, if Git Bash is not installed and the hook command contains only quoted strings, such as a quoted path, PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks (small programs triggered when specific events occur) previously allowed tool calls through by mistake, which has now been fixed. Before the first read outside the working directory in auto mode, the prompt explains under what circumstances blocking these reads will cause subsequent terminal commands to require permissions. Where you might previously have been unable to see where shortcuts lead or understand cascading permission effects, each prompt now provides clear explanations and hooks act as reliable gatekeepers.

items.original:
Fixed file read permission prompts not showing where a symbolic link leads
Windows: Fixed PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks letting a tool call through when Git Bash is missing and the hook's command is only quoted strings, such as a quoted path
Improved auto mode's prompt before the first read outside the working directories: it now says when blocking those reads makes shell commands ask for permission

title.zh-TW: 外部編輯器長時間編輯關閉後，不再立即觸發逾時自動繼續
title.en: Closing an External Editor After a Long Edit No Longer Immediately Triggers Auto-Continue Timeout

body.zh-TW: 回答問題時，你可能會在 Vim 或 VS Code 等外部編輯器中仔細推敲回覆內容。以前編輯較久後關閉視窗，自動繼續的逾時會在關閉瞬間觸發。現在這個計時問題已經修好，不會再於關閉瞬間觸發。
body.en: When answering questions, you might carefully draft your response in an external editor such as Vim or VS Code. Previously, after editing for an extended period and closing the window, the auto-continue timeout would trigger the moment it closed. This timing issue has now been fixed and will no longer fire at the instant of closing.

items.original: Fixed a question's auto-continue timeout firing the moment the external editor closed after a long edit

title.zh-TW: tmux 內啟用直通時，kitty、Ghostty 與 iTerm2 可正常繪製模組圖片
title.en: kitty, Ghostty, and iTerm2 Can Render Mod Images Inside tmux with Passthrough Enabled

body.zh-TW: 平時習慣在 kitty、Ghostty 或 iTerm2 3.5 以上版本的終端機裡開啟全螢幕渲染，並搭配 tmux 多工器工作的使用者，現在模組的圖片元件能正確繪製畫面。只要你在 tmux 中開啟 allow-passthrough 直通選項與 focus-events 焦點事件，模組內的圖片元件就能直接顯示圖像。⟦站在特製玻璃窗前觀賞室內畫展時，以前若拉上雙層隔板，參觀者只能透過底部的標籤紙閱讀文字說明；現在只要開啟專用透光通道與感應開關，窗內鮮豔的畫作就能原汁原味投射出來。⟧在此之前，符合這些條件的終端機環境往往無法渲染圖形，畫面只會乾巴巴地印出替代文字（alt text）。這項改進讓終端機內的視覺外掛與圖片預覽恢復正常顯示。
body.en: Users who customarily enable fullscreen rendering in kitty, Ghostty, or iTerm2 3.5+ while working with the tmux multiplexer can now have a mod's Image component render properly. As long as you turn on the allow-passthrough option and focus-events inside tmux, the Image component in the mod can display pictures directly. ⟦Think of viewing an indoor art exhibition behind a special glass window: previously, if a double partition was drawn, visitors could only read text descriptions through bottom label strips; now, as long as you open the dedicated light-transmitting channel and sensor switch, the brightly colored paintings inside can be projected as intended.⟧ Prior to this, terminal environments matching these conditions often failed to render graphics, printing only plain alt text on the screen. This improvement restores visual plugins and image previews inside the terminal to normal display.

items.original: Improved a mod's `Image` to draw inside tmux with `allow-passthrough` and `focus-events` on, in kitty, Ghostty, and iTerm2 3.5+ with fullscreen rendering, where it showed only its `alt` text

title.zh-TW: Linux 沙盒啟動受阻時，提示 Ubuntu 的 AppArmor 限制與解除方式
title.en: Linux Names Ubuntu AppArmor Restrictions and Fixes When Sandbox Startup Is Blocked

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 系統尤其是 Ubuntu 環境下啟動隔離沙盒時，安全機制有時會引發衝突。當系統安全模組 AppArmor 對使用者命名空間（user namespaces）的存取限制導致底層工具 bubblewrap 無法順利啟動沙盒時，/sandbox 指令與啟動警告現在會明確點名這項具體原因。⟦向大樓管理處申請租借活動隔間時，以前警衛發現施工許可不足時只在門口亮紅燈，讓人完全摸不著頭緒；現在告示牌會明確寫出是大樓的防火防護條例限制了臨時搭棚，並附上前往服務台簽署豁免文件的具體步驟。⟧提示訊息中會詳細列出 Ubuntu 的限制來源，並同步說明解除封鎖的操作方法，遇到沙盒無法啟動時不必再去翻找系統日誌除錯。
body.en: When starting an isolated sandbox on Linux, particularly in an Ubuntu environment, security mechanisms sometimes cause conflicts. When AppArmor restrictions on user namespaces prevent the underlying tool bubblewrap from starting the sandbox smoothly, the /sandbox command and startup warnings now explicitly name this specific cause. ⟦Consider renting a movable partition from building management: previously, guards merely flashed a red light at the entrance when construction permits fell short, leaving people completely puzzled; now, signs explicitly state that building fire prevention codes restrict temporary canopies and provide concrete steps to visit the service desk to sign an exemption document.⟧ The prompt details the source of the Ubuntu restriction while explaining how to lift it, so you no longer have to dig through system logs to troubleshoot when a sandbox fails to start.

items.original: Linux: Improved `/sandbox` and the sandbox startup warning to name Ubuntu's AppArmor restriction on user namespaces, and how to lift it, when it keeps bubblewrap from starting the sandbox

title.zh-TW: 非互動模式下 MCP 工具詢問逾時，通知 Claude 勿重複呼叫
title.en: MCP Tool Prompt Timeouts in Non-Interactive Mode Inform Claude Not to Repeat Calls

body.zh-TW: 藉由指令碼或自動化排程執行非互動工作階段，並調用 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具時，雙向溝通若卡住會影響後續決策。如果工具伺服器在執行中拋出進一步詢問，而在無人值守的非互動狀態下無人應答導致逾時，系統傳回的錯誤訊息現在有了具體調整。⟦總機櫃檯透過廣播呼叫未到場的訪客時，以前若無人應答，系統只回傳線路逾時代碼，導致助理不斷重複廣播同一通呼叫；現在櫃檯會收到註記無人前來的單據，明確告知不要再次呼叫，直接依現況結案。⟧新的錯誤回報會清楚告訴 Claude 剛剛並未收到任何答案，並指示它不要再重複嘗試發起相同的工具呼叫，防止自動化任務陷入無意義的死循環。
body.en: When running non-interactive sessions via scripts or automated schedules and invoking MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol connecting AI to external tools) tools, stalled two-way communication impacts subsequent decisions. If a tool server raises a further inquiry during execution and nobody responds in the unattended non-interactive state causing a timeout, the error message returned by the system has now been specifically adjusted. ⟦Imagine a reception desk paging an absent visitor over the intercom: previously, if no one answered, the system only returned a line timeout code, leading the assistant to repeatedly broadcast the same page; now, the desk receives a slip noting that no one arrived, explicitly directing them not to page again and to close the matter as is.⟧ The updated error report clearly informs Claude that no answer arrived and instructs it not to retry the same tool call, preventing automated tasks from falling into meaningless dead loops.

items.original: Changed the error for an MCP tool call that times out in a non-interactive session while the server's elicitation is unanswered: it now tells Claude that no answer came and not to repeat the call

title.zh-TW: VS Code 修復計畫意見回饋誤核准，與雲端切換分支報錯
title.en: VS Code Fixes Feedback Misapproval on Plans and Cloud Branch Switching Errors

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 擴充套件中審查規劃步驟或管理歷史紀錄時，兩處按鈕互動問題已經修復。在計畫審查卡片中，當你輸入修改建議並對「Send feedback and keep planning」按鈕按下 Enter 鍵時，以前擴充套件會錯誤地直接核准整份計畫，而非將你的意見送回重新規劃。⟦填寫紙本問卷調查時，以前按下意見欄的提交鈕卻被櫃檯當作同意跳過後續步驟，從網頁存檔調閱檔案切換工作夾時面板甚至直接黑屏；現在遞交回饋會確實退回修正，跨分頁切換分支時也能平穩銜接。⟧另一項修復針對工作階段歷史（Session history）的 Web 標籤頁：點開雲端工作階段並點擊「Switch branch & continue」切換分支後，面板不會再無端跳出「Something went wrong」的報錯訊息。
body.en: When reviewing planning steps or managing history in the VS Code extension, two button interaction issues have been fixed. In the plan review card, when you type feedback suggestions and press Enter on the "Send feedback and keep planning" button, the extension previously mistakenly approved the entire plan rather than sending your comments back for re-planning. ⟦Take filling out a paper survey: previously, pressing the submit button in the feedback field was mistakenly treated by the front desk as approval that skipped follow-up steps, and retrieving files from web archives to switch folders even caused the panel to go black; now, submitting feedback reliably sends it back for revision, and switching branches across tabs transitions smoothly.⟧ Another fix addresses the Web tab in Session history: after opening a cloud session and clicking "Switch branch & continue" to switch branches, the panel will no longer unexpectedly pop up a "Something went wrong" error message.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed pressing Enter on the plan review card's "Send feedback and keep planning" button approving the plan instead of sending your comments back
[VSCode] Fixed the panel showing "Something went wrong" after "Switch branch & continue" on a cloud session opened from Session history's Web tab

title.zh-TW: 企業自訂角色支援雲端工作階段與遠端控制，開啟前列出授權清單
title.en: Enterprise Custom Roles Support Cloud Sessions and Remote Control, Listing Granted Roles Before Activation

body.zh-TW: 公司想要開放成員使用新工具，卻又擔心權限範圍無法精準控管。Enterprise 自訂角色現在正式納入 Claude Code 雲端工作階段與遠端控制的存取權限，所有者可依據各團隊職責分別授予或收回。⟦企業總部的門禁通行系統調整了高階防護規則，以前開啟特殊機房通道時只要扳動總開關便直接放行，容易忽略哪些部門持有感應磁扣；現在扳下開關時系統會跳出確認視窗，逐一列出擁有進出權限的職務清單，避免權限意外大開。⟧配合這項調整，在管理員設定中開啟這兩項功能時，介面會主動要求你再次確認，並完整列出目前已擁有該權限的自訂角色，防止權限在不知情的情況下外溢。
body.en: Companies want to let members use new tools without losing precise control over permission boundaries. Enterprise custom roles now officially include access permissions for Claude Code cloud sessions and Remote Control, allowing Owners to grant or revoke access based on team responsibilities. ⟦A corporate headquarters updates its high-level security protocol for access gates. Previously, flipping a master switch immediately opened passage to a secure server room, making it easy to overlook which departments held keycards. Flipping that switch now brings up a confirmation prompt that lists every job title with access clearance, preventing permissions from widening unintentionally.⟧ Alongside this change, turning on either feature in admin settings now prompts you for confirmation and lists the custom roles that currently hold that permission, preventing unintended privilege expansion.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Added Claude Code cloud sessions and Remote Control permissions to Enterprise custom roles, so Owners can control access to each by role
[Cloud sessions] Changed turning on Cloud sessions or Remote Control in admin settings to ask for confirmation and list the custom roles that have that permission

title.zh-TW: 雲端環境設定支援檔案載入腳本，排版簡化並明列對話框錯誤
title.en: Cloud Environment Settings Support Script File Loading with a Simplified Layout and In-Dialog Errors

body.zh-TW: 網頁介面上配置雲端工作階段的執行環境與例行排程時，多項表單操作與錯誤反饋獲得改善。環境設定對話框調整了版面結構，網路存取權限、安裝腳本與環境變數改由各自獨立的整列項目展開，不再把所有編輯區塊一口氣全塞在同一個畫面中。在載入安裝腳本時，新增了「Choose file」按鈕，讓你能直接選取檔案上傳。工作階段啟動檢查清單中的腳本輸出，現在也收納在可捲動的方框內，方便閱讀長篇日誌。錯誤回報方面，在雲端環境編輯對話框中執行儲存或封存若不幸失敗，內部會直接顯示錯誤說明。例行排程的 API 授權令牌（token，用來驗證身分的授權代碼）操作若遭遇失敗，錯誤也不再只是短暫閃過快顯通知，而是完整呈現在編輯對話框內。
body.en: Several form interactions and error reporting behaviors have been improved when configuring cloud session runtime environments and routines on the web interface. The cloud environment dialog refines its layout structure, opening network access, setup script, and environment variables from dedicated rows instead of listing every editor at once on a single screen. A new "Choose file" button lets you select and upload a setup script directly from a file. Setup script output in the session start checklist now appears inside a scrolling box, making long logs easier to read. For error reporting, failed saves and archives in the cloud environment edit dialog now display an error message directly inside the dialog. If an action on a routine API token (an authorization code used to verify identity) fails, the error no longer flashes only as a toast notification, but appears fully inside the routine edit dialog.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Added a Choose file button to load a cloud environment's setup script from a file
[Cloud sessions] Fixed failed saves and archives in the cloud environment edit dialog showing no error inside the dialog
[Cloud sessions] Fixed failed routine API token actions showing only a toast; the error now appears in the routine edit dialog
[Cloud sessions] Improved the session start checklist to show a cloud environment's setup script output in a scrolling box
[Cloud sessions] Changed the cloud environment dialog to open network access, setup script and environment variables from rows instead of listing every editor at once

title.zh-TW: Claude Tag 支援富文字格式指令，並修正後台載入與篩選錯誤
title.en: Claude Tag Supports Formatted Commands and Fixes Admin Loading and Filtering Errors

body.zh-TW: 使用 Claude Tag 協同工具時，指令辨識與管理後台修正了多項介面顯示異常。以往在聊天視窗中輸入帶有驚嘆號的指令（例如 `!restart` 與 `!help`）時，若套用了粗體、斜體或刪除線等文字造型，系統會誤當成普通文字聊天而忽略執行，現在帶有格式的指令均能正常被辨識與觸發。在管理後台方面，背景重新整理套件組合清單若發生暫時性失敗，管理頻道與工作區頁面不會再直接被整片錯誤畫面取代，保留原有操作介面。在管理員設定的支出上限頁面中，頻道名稱載入期間若套用篩選條件，系統也不會再過早斷定查無頻道，避免載入中途產生誤導。
body.en: Several display issues in command recognition and the admin console have been resolved when using the Claude Tag collaboration tool. When entering `!` commands (such as `!restart` and `!help`) in a chat window, applying text formatting like bold, italic, or strikethrough previously caused the system to treat them as ordinary messages and skip execution. Formatted commands are now recognized and executed properly. In the admin console, if a background refresh of the bundle list encounters a temporary failure, the admin channel and workspace pages are no longer replaced entirely by a load error, preserving the existing interface. On the spend limits page in admin settings, applying a filter while channel names are still loading will no longer prematurely report that no channels match, avoiding confusion midway through loading.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag treating `!` commands such as `!restart` and `!help` as ordinary messages when sent in bold, italic or strikethrough
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag admin channel and workspace pages being replaced by a load error when a background refresh of the bundle list fails
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings reporting that no channels match a filter while channel names are still loading

title.zh-TW: Code Review 儲存庫載入失敗自動重試，並維持列表正常顯示
title.en: Code Review Retries Failed Repository Loads Automatically and Preserves the List Display

body.zh-TW: 管理後台配置程式碼審查（Code Review）的儲存庫清單時，重新整理失敗的畫面處理獲得改善。以前只要儲存庫清單背景重新整理失敗，管理區塊就會把所有已設定的儲存庫與功能切換開關整片隱藏，造成管理員無法操作。⟦圖書館閱覽室更新藏書架目錄時，以前只要網路斷線查不到最新清單，管理員便把整排架子全部蓋上黑布隱藏；現在不僅會自動再次連線抓取，連線失敗時也會維持原有書冊展示，只在頂部掛上一張醒目的重試牌子。⟧現在當首次載入清單遭遇問題時，系統會自動發起重試；如果重試後依然無法取得資料，頁面會跳出單一「Try again」橫幅方便你手動再次嘗試，不再無故清空畫面上的儲存庫與開關。
body.en: Screen handling during a failed refresh has been improved when configuring repository lists for Code Review in the admin console. Previously, whenever a background refresh of the repository list failed, the admin section completely hid all configured repositories and switches, preventing administrators from taking action. ⟦A library reading room updates its shelf catalog. In the past, whenever a network drop prevented staff from fetching the newest list, the librarian draped black cloths over the entire row of shelves to hide them completely. Now the system automatically attempts to reconnect, keeps the existing books on display if the connection fails, and hangs a single visible retry sign above the shelf.⟧ The system now automatically retries when the initial list load encounters an issue. If data still cannot be retrieved after retrying, the page displays a single "Try again" banner for manual retry instead of clearing repositories and switches from the screen.

items.original:
[Code Review] Fixed the Code Review admin section hiding its repositories and switches after a failed refresh of the repository list
[Code Review] Improved the Code Review admin section to retry the first load and show one Try again banner when it still fails

Fixed split-pane agent teammates not inheriting the tool deny and `--tools` rules given on the leader's command line
Fixed sessions renamed with `/rename` appearing to other sessions under a generated name after a VS Code window reload or a non-interactive `--resume`

Fixed `/privacy-settings` showing an out-of-date "Help improve our AI models" value; it now also says when the setting can't be fetched
Fixed feedback saying "try again later" when your organization does not accept feedback; it now shows the server's reason and where to report a bug

Fixed a skill in an `--add-dir` folder being unreachable when another skill already held its name; it is now offered as `<folder>:<name>`

Fixed a mod's `turn.step` hook that names a model by alias, such as `haiku`, failing every request with a model error: the alias now resolves to its model
Fixed plugins and skills synced from claude.ai being removed, sometimes mid-session, after a disk read error

Fixed fine-grained tool streaming staying off on Amazon Bedrock when `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` is set to the default `bedrock-runtime.<region>.amazonaws.com` endpoint

Linux: Fixed sandbox write denies lifting when a background command outlived the session

macOS: Fixed the "Install Command Line Developer Tools" dialog opening each time Claude Code starts on a Mac without Xcode or the Command Line Tools
