title.zh-TW: ultrareview 嚴格檢查工作區信任，未獲授權立即中斷
title.en: ultrareview Enforces Workspace Trust Checks, Halting Immediately Without Authorization

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機使用 `claude ultrareview` 進行進階程式碼審查時，工具現在會主動確認目前工作區是否值得信任。在一般終端機下它會跳出確認提問，若沒有互動終端或在自動化環境則會直接拒絕執行。在自動化腳本中，你必須加入不帶參數的 `--trust-workspace` 旗標（需放在 PR 編號或基準分支後面）。或者設定環境變數（執行時讀取的設定值）`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1`。⟦好比大樓警衛室只讓登記過的訪客上樓，以前審查員可能直接走進私人辦公室，現在必須先刷卡確認訪客名單，未登記者一律在門外擋下。⟧當你在持續整合伺服器上排程跑深度審查，卻發現指令中斷時，可按上述位置補上信任旗標，通過工作區信任檢查。
body.en: When you run advanced code reviews in the terminal using `claude ultrareview`, the tool now actively verifies whether the current workspace is trusted. In a standard terminal, it prompts for confirmation, but it directly refuses execution if there is no interactive terminal or inside an automated environment. In automated scripts, you must include the `--trust-workspace` flag with no arguments (placed after the PR number or base branch). Alternatively, you can set the environment variable (configuration values read at runtime) `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1`. ⟦Picture a building security desk that only allows registered visitors upstairs: where reviewers could previously walk straight into private offices, they must now badge in against the visitor log, and anyone unlisted is stopped at the door.⟧ When a scheduled in-depth review on a continuous integration server stops unexpectedly, add the trust flag in the position described above to pass the workspace trust check.

items.original: Changed `claude ultrareview` to require workspace trust: it asks on a terminal, else refuses; scripts pass `--trust-workspace`, which takes no value (put a PR number or base branch before it), or set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1`

title.zh-TW: /claude-api 技能換裝多代理人架構，預設啟用動態工作流程
title.en: /claude-api Skill Adopts Multi-Agent Architecture, Enabling Dynamic Workflows by Default

body.zh-TW: 當你透過 `/claude-api` 技能規劃雲端代理人團隊時，背後生成團隊的底層範本已經升級。以往工具會採用舊有的協調員架構（coordinator）。現在改以 `multiagent_20261001` 架構建立 Managed Agents（由平台託管的代理人）子團隊，並預設開啟動態工作流程。⟦宛如專案工作室調整團隊編制，以前沿用舊的組織方式，現在改用新的團隊組織方式。⟧當你需要為多步驟任務設計多個助理分工時，直接呼叫 `/claude-api`，產出的代理人團隊就會採用這套架構，動態工作流程也已預設開啟。
body.en: When you design cloud agent teams through the `/claude-api` skill, the underlying template generating those teams has been upgraded. Previously, the tool relied on the legacy coordinator architecture. It now builds Managed Agents (agents hosted by the platform) subteams using the `multiagent_20261001` architecture, with dynamic workflows enabled by default. ⟦A project studio reorganizes its staffing: where it previously relied on an older organizational setup, it now adopts a new team structure.⟧ When you need to delegate multi-step tasks across multiple assistants, call `/claude-api` directly, and the generated agent team will use this architecture with dynamic workflows turned on by default.

items.original: Changed the `/claude-api` skill to build Managed Agents subagent teams on `multiagent_20261001` with dynamic workflows on by default, instead of `coordinator`

title.zh-TW: sed -i 採用標準指令確認，修改內容不再交由 /rewind 復原
title.en: sed -i Adopts Standard Command Prompts, Leaving Edits Outside /rewind Restoration

body.zh-TW: 在對話中要求 Claude 直接批次替換檔案文字時，`sed -i` 指令的執行與確認流程有了調整。以前這類就地修改指令會跳出模擬的檔案編輯預覽，現在它改為顯示標準的 Bash 執行提示，並依照輸入的原文直接運行。與其他透過 Bash 進行的修改一樣，執行過後的檔案變更不會再被 `/rewind` 指令復原。⟦跟在便條紙上動筆塗改一樣，以前動筆前會先在旁邊墊一張描圖紙給你看預覽，現在直接按指令在紙上落筆。⟧如果你打算在大量程式碼中批次取代變數名稱，執行前請確認修改內容，因為 `/rewind` 不會復原這類修改。
body.en: When you ask Claude to batch-replace file text in a conversation, the execution and confirmation flow for the `sed -i` command has been adjusted. Previously, this in-place modification command displayed a simulated file edit preview. It now displays a standard Bash execution prompt and runs directly with the verbatim input. Like other modifications made through Bash, resulting file changes will no longer be restored by the `/rewind` command. ⟦Think of writing corrections on a notepad: where you once placed tracing paper over the page to preview changes, you now put pen directly to paper as instructed.⟧ If you plan to batch-replace variable names across extensive code, verify your changes before running, because `/rewind` will not undo these modifications.

items.original: Changed `sed -i` to get the standard Bash prompt and run as written, not a simulated file-edit preview; like other Bash edits, it is no longer restored by `/rewind`

title.zh-TW: 補強沙盒隔離防線，嚴格限制設定檔與捷徑路徑寫入
title.en: Sandbox Isolation Hardened with Stricter Write Limits on Configs and Symlinks

body.zh-TW: 當你在 macOS 與 Linux 上啟用沙盒執行指令時，多項環境隔離與檔案寫入的防護邊界獲得了修正。沙盒內的 Bash 指令以前會在執行前於沙盒外載入 Shell 啟動檔，現在不會在隔離環境外偷跑。當目錄透過符號連結（指向真實位置的捷徑檔）連接時，macOS 的 `denyWrite` 規則現在會確實比對目標的真實位置，設定檔儲存庫的防寫限制也不會被捷徑繞過。沙盒指令與自動核准的修改不再能更動由 `--mcp-config` 指定的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）設定檔。在 Linux 環境中，背景指令即使存活超過原本的工作階段，沙盒禁止寫入的防線也不再提早解除。若沙盒處於啟用但無法運作的狀態，排除於沙盒外的指令在寫入允許清單的路徑前會主動跳出確認，並直接拒絕未隔離的備援操作。
body.en: When you enable sandboxing to run commands on macOS and Linux, several protection boundaries for environment isolation and file writes have been fixed. Bash commands inside the sandbox previously loaded Shell startup files outside the sandbox before execution. They no longer run outside the isolated environment. When directories are connected via symlinks (shortcut files pointing to real locations), macOS `denyWrite` rules now accurately match the real target location, preventing shortcuts from bypassing write restrictions on configuration repositories. Sandboxed commands and auto-approved modifications can no longer alter MCP (Model Context Protocol, enabling AI to connect with external tools) configuration files specified by `--mcp-config`. In Linux environments, even if background commands outlive their original session, write-prohibition boundaries in the sandbox are no longer lifted prematurely. If the sandbox is enabled but non-functional, commands exempted from the sandbox will prompt for confirmation before writing to allowlisted paths, while un-isolated fallback operations are rejected outright.

items.original:
Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on macOS and Linux running the shell's startup files outside the sandbox before each command
Fixed macOS sandbox `denyWrite` glob patterns not applying at a path's real location when the pattern's folder is reached through a symlink
Fixed sandboxed commands and auto-accepted edits being able to modify the MCP config file passed with `--mcp-config`
Fixed profile store write protection not applying when the config directory is reached through a symlink
Linux: Fixed sandbox write denies lifting when a background command outlived the session
Changed commands the settings exclude from the sandbox to ask before writing to its write-list paths while the sandbox is enabled but cannot run; the unsandboxed fallback is refused there

title.zh-TW: 終端機強化指令審核，嚴防重導向與目錄切換繞過授權
title.en: Terminal Strengthens Command Auditing, Blocking Redirection and Directory Changes Bypasses

body.zh-TW: 當 Claude 在終端機執行複合指令或刪除檔案時，幾處曾會漏掉權限提示或錯誤信任狀態的盲點已全數修復。Bash 權限檢查以前會盲目信任由指令設定的變數，即使該指令的輸出重導向根本無法開啟；現在不會再誤判為成功。當指令在執行 git 前先變更目錄，若 `cd` 被包裝或帶有前綴，Bash 檢查現在會像一般 `cd` 一樣確實跳出確認提示。當複合指令包含子 Shell 時，`Edit(path)` 阻擋規則現在能確實攔截指向該路徑的重導向寫入。在 Windows 上，若 `Set-Location` 或 `cd` 目標為當前目錄但帶有額外參數，PowerShell 權限檢查不再自動放行，而是會跳出核准詢問。桌面應用程式與 VS Code 在略過權限模式下若遇到危險的 `rm` 與 `rmdir` 指令，現在會直接拒絕並附上改寫建議，避免無人值守的工作階段卡在確認畫面。
body.en: When Claude runs compound commands or deletes files in the terminal, several blind spots that previously missed permission prompts or falsely trusted state have been fixed. Bash permission checks previously blindly trusted variables set by a command even if output redirection failed to open. They no longer misjudge such executions as successful. When a command changes directories before running git, Bash checks now properly prompt for confirmation if `cd` is wrapped or prefixed, matching standard `cd` behavior. When compound commands contain subshells, `Edit(path)` blocking rules now reliably intercept redirection writes targeting that path. On Windows, if `Set-Location` or `cd` targets the current directory with extra arguments, PowerShell permission checks no longer auto-approve the command, prompting for confirmation instead. When dangerous `rm` and `rmdir` commands run in bypass permissions mode, the desktop app and VS Code now reject them directly with rewrite suggestions, preventing unattended sessions from stalling on confirmation prompts.

items.original:
Fixed the Bash permission check trusting a variable set by a command whose redirect can fail to open
Fixed Bash permission checks not prompting for some compound commands that change directory before running git when the `cd` is wrapped or prefixed, as they do for a plain `cd`
Fixed an `Edit(path)` deny rule not blocking a Bash redirect to that path in some commands that also held a subshell
Windows: Fixed PowerShell permission checks auto-approving some `Set-Location` or `cd` commands that target the current directory and carry extra arguments; these now prompt for approval
Changed the dangerous `rm` and `rmdir` prompt in bypass permissions mode in the Desktop app and VS Code to deny the command at once with a rewrite hint, so unattended sessions keep going

title.zh-TW: 收緊工作樹隔離防護，Git 操作提速並預先載入物件
title.en: Worktree Isolation Guard Tightened, Accelerating Git Operations and Pre-fetching Objects

body.zh-TW: 當你啟用隔離環境讓多個對話平行處理不同任務時，版本控制與工作目錄的邊界防護有了重要改善。工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）隔離的工作階段中，先前部分帶有語系前綴、原本應被隔離守衛拒絕的指令會被放行，現在已修正；zsh 下原本會漏網的算術運算指令也會被阻擋。由 Claude Code 建立的工作樹與分支簽出，現在會像其他 Git 操作一樣主動忽略替換參照（replace refs）。Windows 上多項內部 Git 指令變快；在所有平台上，這些指令的錯誤訊息都改以英文顯示，不受 Git 語言設定影響。在一般複製品或設定了 Bash 沙盒的部分複製品中，建立與重複使用工作樹時不再隨選抓取物件；這類部分複製品會先抓取物件，再建立或重複使用工作樹。
body.en: When you enable isolated environments so multiple conversations can handle different tasks in parallel, boundary protections for version control and working directories have improved significantly. Inside sessions isolated by worktrees (Git features that maintain parallel copies of the same project), commands with locale prefixes that should have been rejected by the isolation guard previously slipped through, but this is now fixed. Arithmetic commands under zsh that previously went unnoticed are also blocked. Worktrees and branch checkouts created by Claude Code now actively ignore replace references, matching other Git operations. Multiple internal Git commands are faster on Windows. Across all platforms, error messages from these commands are now displayed in English, regardless of Git locale settings. In standard clones or partial clones configured with Bash sandboxing, creating and reusing worktrees no longer fetches objects on demand. Such partial clones now pre-fetch objects before creating or reusing a worktree.

items.original:
Fixed worktree-isolated sessions accepting some locale-prefixed commands the isolation guard should refuse
Fixed worktree-isolated sessions on zsh accepting some arithmetic commands that the isolation guard should refuse
Fixed worktrees and branch checkouts that Claude Code creates so they ignore git replace refs, as its other git operations already do
Improved the speed of many git commands Claude Code runs for itself on Windows; on every platform, errors from those commands now show in English even when git is set to another language
Changed worktree creation and reuse so git no longer fetches objects on demand, in ordinary clones and in partial clones with a Bash sandbox configured; such a partial clone fetches them first

title.zh-TW: /claude-api 擴充雲端追蹤支援，查核即時文件並開放授權令牌
title.en: /claude-api Expands Cloud Tracing Support, Verifying Live Docs and Enabling Auth Tokens

body.zh-TW: 當你請 `/claude-api` 技能協助配置雲端服務與鏈路追蹤時，多項說明準確度與追蹤設定已獲得改善。技能說明不再誤稱 `ant beta:worker poll --on-work` 會傳遞追蹤上下文。修正 C# 追蹤配置遺漏雲端平台客戶端跨度（spans）的瑕疵。修正原本聲稱 AWS 上的 Claude Platform 請求跨度無法加入呼叫端追蹤的錯誤說法。要求加入 OpenTelemetry 時，技能現在會在 SDK 追蹤之外同時主動提供 API 追蹤選項。技能在回覆功能不受支援前，會先連線查核最新即時官方文件。服務帳號金鑰與工作負載身分同盟的授權令牌（用來驗證身分的數位令牌），現在已可用於管理 OpenTelemetry 的輸出目的地。
body.en: When you ask the `/claude-api` skill to configure cloud services and distributed tracing, several documentation accuracies and tracing settings have been improved. The skill description no longer mistakenly claims that `ant beta:worker poll --on-work` propagates trace context. It fixes an issue in C# tracing setups where cloud platform client spans were omitted. It corrects the inaccurate claim that Claude Platform request spans on AWS cannot join caller traces. When asked to add OpenTelemetry, the skill now proactively provides API tracing options alongside SDK tracing. Before responding that a feature is unsupported, the skill now connects online to verify against current official documentation. Service account keys and authorization tokens (digital credentials used for identity verification) from workload identity federation can now be used to manage OpenTelemetry export destinations.

items.original:
Fixed the /claude-api skill saying that `ant beta:worker poll --on-work` passes trace context to the command
Fixed the /claude-api skill's C# tracing setup missing spans from the cloud platform clients
Fixed the /claude-api skill saying that API spans for requests to Claude Platform on AWS can't join the caller's trace
Improved the /claude-api skill to offer API tracing alongside SDK tracing when asked to add OpenTelemetry
Improved the /claude-api skill to check the live docs before saying a feature is unsupported
Updated the /claude-api skill: service account keys and Workload Identity Federation tokens can now manage OpenTelemetry destinations

title.zh-TW: 技能命名支援目錄前綴區隔，資料圖表導入新版對比標準
title.en: Skill Names Support Directory Prefixes, Introducing Modern Contrast Standards to Dataviz

body.zh-TW: 當你在專案中載入多組外掛或自訂技能時，技能重複衝突與檔案讀取例外處理已得到修復。透過 `--add-dir` 載入的技能若與既有技能同名，以前會無法使用，現在會自動加上前綴顯示為 `<folder>:<name>`。在終端機 Shell 變更檔案後，`/verify` 與 `/code-review` 不再發生找不到巢狀套件自身技能的問題。從 claude.ai 同步的外掛與技能，在遭遇磁碟讀取錯誤時不會再於工作階段中途莫名被整組移除。內建的 dataviz 資料視覺化技能正式支援 APCA 文字對比度演算標準（在需要符合 AA 規範處仍維持 WCAG 2 比例），調色盤驗證腳本新增 `apca(text, background)` 函式，並能指引圖表著色區塊內的標籤該搭配白色或接近黑色。
body.en: When you load multiple plugins or custom skills into a project, duplicate skill collisions and file-read exception handling have been resolved. If a skill loaded via `--add-dir` shares the same name as an existing skill, it was previously unusable. It is now automatically prefixed as `<folder>:<name>`. After modifying files in the terminal Shell, `/verify` and `/code-review` no longer encounter issues locating skills belonging to nested packages. Plugins and skills synced from claude.ai are no longer removed entirely mid-session when encountering disk read errors. The built-in dataviz skill officially supports the APCA text contrast algorithm standard (while maintaining WCAG 2 ratios where AA compliance is required). Its palette verification script introduces the `apca(text, background)` function and guides whether labels inside shaded chart regions should pair with white or near-black.

items.original:
Fixed a skill in an `--add-dir` folder being unreachable when another skill already held its name; it is now offered as `<folder>:<name>`
Fixed `/verify` and `/code-review` not finding a nested package's own skill when its files were changed from the shell
Fixed plugins and skills synced from claude.ai being removed, sometimes mid-session, after a disk read error
Updated the bundled dataviz skill to accept APCA as a text-contrast measure (keeping WCAG 2 ratios where AA conformance is required), add an `apca(text, background)` function to its palette validator scripts, and say whether a label inside a colored chart fill should be white or near-black

title.zh-TW: 修正對話送出與檢視快捷鍵，工具預覽文字妥善處理表情符號
title.en: Shortcut Keys for Sending and Viewing Fixed, with Better Emoji Handling in Tool Previews

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機快速輸入文字與切換畫面時，快捷鍵的觸發反應與對話紀錄排版獲得了修正。以前在模型回覆開始前按下 ctrl+enter 立即送出，訊息只會進入排隊；若在提示詞掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）執行期間按下，還會重啟掛鉤並將訊息留在等待佇列，現在已徹底修正。在 `!` 開頭的 Shell 模式下，綁定快捷鍵的斜線指令不再錯誤地被丟進系統 Shell 中執行。按下 ctrl+o 時，來自其他代理人與工作階段中等待投遞的訊息，現在會完整標記為等待狀態並顯示在紀錄下方。工具輸出的長預覽文字若剛好截斷在表情符號中間，以往會導致工作階段紀錄損毀而無法被 `jq` 解析，現在已修正截斷處理。
body.en: When you quickly type text and switch views in the terminal, shortcut responsiveness and transcript formatting have been fixed. Previously, pressing ctrl+enter to send immediately before the model began responding merely queued the message. If pressed while prompt hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) were executing, it restarted the hook and left the message stranded in the queue, which is now resolved. In Shell mode prefixed with `!`, slash commands bound to shortcuts are no longer erroneously forwarded to the system Shell for execution. When pressing ctrl+o, pending messages awaiting delivery from other agents and sessions are now fully flagged as pending and displayed at the bottom of the log. If long preview text from tool output was truncated in the middle of an emoji, it previously corrupted the session transcript and prevented `jq` from parsing it, which has now been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed ctrl+enter (send now) only queuing a message when pressed before the response had started, and restarting a prompt's hooks while leaving the message queued when pressed while those hooks were running
Fixed key-bound slash commands running in the shell from `!` mode
Fixed ctrl+o not showing messages from other agents and sessions that are still waiting to be delivered; they now appear in full under the transcript, marked as waiting
Fixed long tool output previews being cut through an emoji, leaving session transcripts that `jq` could not parse

title.zh-TW: 隊友代理人繼承工具限制，自架執行器接軌中斷操作
title.en: Teammate Agents Inherit Tool Restrictions, Bridging Interrupted Operations on Self-Hosted Runners

body.zh-TW: 當你啟動分割視窗的隊友代理人或在自架伺服器上執行任務時，跨代理人設定傳遞與狀態銜接更為一致。分割視窗中的隊友代理人現在會確實繼承隊長在指令列指定的工具禁用規則與 `--tools` 限制。透過 `/rename` 重新命名的工作階段，在 VS Code 視窗重新載入或非互動式 `--resume` 恢復後，不會再以隨機產生的名稱顯示給其他對話。若該回合透過 `/code-review --fix`、子代理人或 Shell 指令修改了已納入檢查點的檔案，`/rewind` 清單不再誤顯示「沒有程式碼變更」。在自架執行器環境中，若首個提示詞仍在子代理人中運作，`--startup-timeout-min` 不會誤殺工作階段，但凍結的行程仍會被停止。當工作階段轉移到新的自架執行器時，Claude 現在能清楚看見被中斷的工具呼叫，並將其標記為結果未知。
body.en: When you launch split-pane teammate agents or run tasks on self-hosted servers, cross-agent configuration propagation and state transitions are more consistent. Teammate agents in split panes now properly inherit tool disablement rules and `--tools` restrictions specified on the command line by the lead agent. Sessions renamed via `/rename` no longer revert to randomly generated names when viewed from other conversations after a VS Code window reload or a non-interactive `--resume`. If a turn modifies checkpointed files through `/code-review --fix`, subagents, or Shell commands, the `/rewind` list no longer erroneously displays 'no code changes'. In self-hosted runner environments, `--startup-timeout-min` will not terminate the session prematurely if the initial prompt is still active in a subagent, though frozen processes are still stopped. When a session transitions to a new self-hosted runner, Claude can now clearly see interrupted tool calls and mark them as having an unknown result.

items.original:
Fixed split-pane agent teammates not inheriting the tool deny and `--tools` rules given on the leader's command line
Fixed sessions renamed with `/rename` appearing to other sessions under a generated name after a VS Code window reload or a non-interactive `--resume`
Fixed the `/rewind` list showing "No code changes" for a turn that changed checkpointed files through `/code-review --fix`, a subagent or a shell command
Self-hosted runner: Fixed `--startup-timeout-min` stopping a session whose first prompt, such as `/code-review`, was still working in a subagent; a frozen process is still stopped
Self-hosted runner: Improved sessions that move to a new runner: Claude now sees the tool call that was interrupted, marked as outcome unknown

title.zh-TW: 修復 PowerShell 掛鉤阻擋機制，別名模型自動解析
title.en: PowerShell Hook Blocking Fixed, Aliased Models Automatically Resolve

body.zh-TW: 當你在工作流程中設定自訂掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）以攔截工具或步驟時，Windows 與模組載入的相容性獲得了提升。在 PowerShell 中運行的掛鉤程式若以代碼 2 結束，以往無法成功阻擋操作，現在已能正確攔截。在未安裝 Git for Windows 的 Windows 環境中，指定使用 PowerShell 的工具前置與權限請求掛鉤也不再因缺少該工具而直接失守放行。自訂模組的 `turn.step` 掛鉤中若以別名（例如 `haiku`）指定模型，以前每次請求都會失敗，現在會正確解析出對應模型。當掛鉤模組因巢狀過深而無法載入時，錯誤訊息現在會明確點名出問題的檔案路徑，不再只印出簡略的堆疊溢位提示。
body.en: When configuring custom hooks (small programs triggered when specific events occur) in your workflow to intercept tools or steps, compatibility with Windows and module loading has improved. Hook programs running in PowerShell that exit with code 2 previously failed to block operations, but now intercept them correctly. On Windows environments where Git for Windows is not installed, pre-tool and permission-request hooks specifying PowerShell no longer fail open simply due to the missing tool. If a model is specified by an alias (such as `haiku`) in the `turn.step` hook of a custom module, requests that previously failed every time now correctly resolve the corresponding model. When a hook module fails to load due to excessive nesting, error messages now explicitly identify the problematic file path instead of printing a terse stack overflow notice.

items.original:
Fixed hooks that run in PowerShell not blocking when the hook's program exits with code 2, and on Windows `PreToolUse` and `PermissionRequest` hooks with `"shell": "powershell"` failing open when Git for Windows isn't installed
Fixed a mod's `turn.step` hook that names a model by alias, such as `haiku`, failing every request with a model error: the alias now resolves to its model
Improved the error when a hooks module is nested too deep to load: it now names the file instead of showing a bare stack-overflow message

title.zh-TW: 大型說明檔避免重複壓縮，成品發布與權限不再頻繁卡關
title.en: Large Instruction Files Avoid Repeated Compaction, Artifact Publishing and Permissions No Longer Stall

body.zh-TW: 當對話中包含大量說明文件或正在發布網頁成品時，對話壓縮與成品更新流程不再反覆打擾。讀取受大型巢狀 `CLAUDE.md` 管轄的檔案後，工作階段以前會陷入反覆壓縮對話的循環；現在若巢狀說明檔超出容量上限，工具只會載入檔案開頭部分。發布或更新成品時，以往部分包含特定縮減程式碼（minified scripts）或未被預先讀取的常見頁面會遭到拒絕，現在已能正常發布。在同一個回合中，若對話曾觸發過內容壓縮，Claude 以前會在後續每次更新成品時不斷重複要求授權，這個問題現在已經修復。
body.en: When conversations involve extensive documentation or web artifacts are being published, conversation compaction and artifact update flows no longer cause repeated interruptions. After reading files governed by a large nested `CLAUDE.md`, sessions previously fell into loops of repeatedly compacting conversations. If a nested instructions file exceeds the size limit, the tool now loads only the initial portion of the file. When publishing or updating artifacts, certain common pages containing specific minified scripts or pages that were not preread previously faced rejection, but can now be published normally. If a conversation triggered content compaction within the same turn, Claude previously asked for permission repeatedly on every subsequent artifact update, an issue that is now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed sessions compacting repeatedly after reading files under a very large nested CLAUDE.md; a nested CLAUDE.md over the size limit now loads only its start
Fixed artifact publishes and updates being refused for some ordinary pages, such as pages with certain minified scripts or artifacts Claude could not read first
Fixed Claude asking for permission on each artifact update for the rest of a turn after the conversation was compacted in that turn

title.zh-TW: 桌面工作階段維持連線，遠端狀態列與停用工具不再錯亂
title.en: Desktop Sessions Stay Connected, Remote Status Line and Disabled Tools No Longer Misbehave

body.zh-TW: 當你透過桌面應用程式或遠端控制操作 Claude Code 時，帳號狀態與背景連線的穩定度得到了改善。在列印模式與 SDK 工作階段中，已經停用的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，以前會在後續跳出權限提示時被意外重新連線，現在已維持關閉。在由 Claude 桌面應用程式託管的工作階段中，網路連線重新整理時對話訊息偶爾遺失的問題已經排除。當同一台電腦上的終端機登入了不同帳號或組織時，桌面應用程式中的工作階段以前會遺失部分功能，現在不會再因此缺少功能。針對非 Git 儲存庫的普通資料夾，`claude remote-control` 的狀態列（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）不再將分支名稱錯誤顯示為 `HEAD`。
body.en: When operating Claude Code through the desktop app or remote control, the stability of account status and background connections has improved. In print mode and SDK sessions, disabled MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) servers previously reconnected unexpectedly when permission prompts appeared later, but now remain closed. In sessions hosted by the Claude desktop app, an issue where conversation messages were occasionally lost during network refreshes has been eliminated. When terminals on the same computer are logged into different accounts or organizations, sessions inside the desktop app previously lost certain features, but will no longer miss capabilities as a result. For standard folders that are not Git repositories, the status line (the bar displayed at the bottom of the terminal) of `claude remote-control` no longer mistakenly shows the branch name as `HEAD`.

items.original:
Fixed a disabled MCP server being reconnected by a later permission prompt in print and SDK sessions
Fixed messages from a Claude Desktop-hosted session sometimes being lost when its connection refreshed
Fixed features missing from Claude Code sessions in the Claude desktop app when the terminal on the same computer was signed in to a different account or organization
Fixed the `claude remote-control` status line showing `HEAD` as the branch for a folder that is not in a git repository

title.zh-TW: 隱私設定即時同步，意見回饋與 GitHub 標記精確呈現
title.en: Privacy Settings Sync in Real Time, Feedback and GitHub Mentions Render Accurately

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機檢查隱私設定或向官方回報問題時，回傳的訊息說明與對外發布內容更加清晰。輸入 `/privacy-settings` 時，以前可能顯示過期的「協助改善我們的 AI 模型」開關狀態；現在會即時呈現最新設定，無法取得設定時也會明確告知。當你所屬的組織未開放意見回饋時，送出 `/feedback` 不再只顯示含糊的「請稍後再試」，而是會顯示伺服器提供的具體原因並指引回報錯誤的管道。含有大量紀錄的超大 `/feedback` 報告在傳送失敗時，現在會自動改為排除對話紀錄後重新送出，不再直接報錯中斷。在發布 Pull Request、議題或留言時，Claude 不會再將角色名稱或佔位符寫成 `@` 標籤，避免意外通知到無關的 GitHub 使用者。
body.en: When checking privacy settings in the terminal or reporting issues to the team, returned explanations and public content are much clearer. Running `/privacy-settings` previously might have displayed an outdated toggle state for helping improve AI models, but now displays current settings in real time and clearly states when settings cannot be retrieved. When feedback is not enabled for your organization, submitting `/feedback` no longer merely displays a vague request to try again later, instead presenting the specific reason provided by the server and directing you to bug-reporting channels. When an oversized `/feedback` report containing extensive logs fails to transmit, it now automatically retries after excluding conversation transcripts, rather than aborting directly with an error. When publishing pull requests, issues, or comments, Claude no longer formats role names or placeholders as `@` mentions, preventing unintended notifications to unrelated GitHub users.

items.original:
Fixed `/privacy-settings` showing an out-of-date "Help improve our AI models" value; it now also says when the setting can't be fetched
Fixed feedback saying "try again later" when your organization does not accept feedback; it now shows the server's reason and where to report a bug
Fixed oversized /feedback reports failing instead of being resent without the transcript
Fixed Claude notifying unrelated GitHub users by writing role names and placeholders as mentions in PRs, issues and comments

title.zh-TW: 磁碟空間滿載提供清理指引，修復串流逾時與工具安裝彈窗
title.en: Full Disk Space Provides Cleanup Guidance, Streaming Timeouts and Tool Installation Popups Fixed

body.zh-TW: 當底層系統空間不足或身處特定雲端環境時，錯誤提示與連線等待機制變得更為實用。在共用 `/proc` 的 Linux 沙盒中，讀取工具讀取特定 PDF 頁面範圍不再誤報檔案不存在。在 Amazon Bedrock 將 `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` 設為預設端點時，細粒度串流不會再被錯誤關閉。透過僅發送保持連線訊號（keepalive pings）的閘道連線時，等待 API 回覆提示不再閃爍，非 Anthropic 後端會等待 45 秒。在未安裝 Xcode，也未安裝 Command Line Tools（命令列開發工具）的 Mac 上，啟動 Claude Code 不再每次跳出安裝視窗。磁碟滿載導致 Bash 指令中斷時，會說明原因並點名應釋放空間的資料夾；暫存空間已滿時啟動也會顯示清楚訊息而非晦澀代碼。
body.en: When the underlying system is low on space or running in specific cloud environments, error prompts and connection waiting mechanisms are more practical. Inside Linux sandboxes sharing `/proc`, the read tool no longer falsely reports that files do not exist when reading specific PDF page ranges. When Amazon Bedrock configures `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` as the default endpoint, fine-grained streaming is no longer mistakenly disabled. When connecting through gateways that only send keepalive pings, the prompt waiting for API responses no longer flickers, and non-Anthropic backends wait for 45 seconds. On a Mac with neither Xcode nor Command Line Tools (developer tools for the command line) installed, launching Claude Code no longer triggers an installation popup every time. When Bash commands abort because the disk is full, the tool explains the reason and names the folder where space should be freed. Starting up when temporary storage is full also displays a clear message rather than cryptic codes.

items.original:
Fixed Read reporting "File does not exist" for PDF page ranges in Linux sandboxes that share the parent's `/proc`
Fixed fine-grained tool streaming staying off on Amazon Bedrock when `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` is set to the default `bedrock-runtime.<region>.amazonaws.com` endpoint
Fixed the "Waiting for API response" hint flickering behind gateways that send only keepalive pings: routes off Anthropic's backend now wait 45 seconds
macOS: Fixed the "Install Command Line Developer Tools" dialog opening each time Claude Code starts on a Mac without Xcode or the Command Line Tools
Improved disk-full handling: a Bash command cut off by a full disk now says so and names the folder to free up, and starting on a full temp volume prints a clear message, not a raw ENOSPC error

title.zh-TW: VS Code 聊天面板長訊息支援摺疊，快取損壞自動修復
title.en: VS Code Chat Panel Supports Collapsing Long Messages, Corrupted Cache Automatically Recovers

body.zh-TW: 當你在 VS Code 側邊面板中使用 Claude Code 時，幾處版面繪製與快取異常已經獲得排除。當編輯器因快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）了不完整的檔案而導致 Claude 面板一片空白時，擴充套件現在會自行恢復，或明確提示問題原因與手動解決方法。像 `/goal` 這類過長的斜線指令提示詞，現在會像其他長訊息一樣自動摺疊在展開按鈕後方，即使把聊天面板調窄，長訊息也不會撐破版面。輸入框上方標示來自特定外掛的提示標籤，不再錯誤遮擋斜線指令與 `@` 標註的選單。貼上複製的 LaTeX 數學公式時，不再產生多餘的空白清單項目、空白段落或程式碼區塊，編號清單也不會再被強制從 1 重新起算。
body.en: When using Claude Code in the VS Code side panel, several layout rendering and caching anomalies have been resolved. When the editor caches an incomplete file and causes the Claude panel to go completely blank, the extension now recovers on its own or clearly explains the cause and manual resolution. Lengthy slash command prompts such as `/goal` now automatically collapse behind an expand button just like other long messages, and narrowing the chat panel will no longer cause long messages to break the layout. Hint tags above the input box indicating specific plugins no longer mistakenly obscure menus for slash commands or `@` mentions. Pasting copied LaTeX mathematical formulas no longer creates superfluous empty list items, blank paragraphs, or code blocks, and numbered lists are no longer forced to restart from 1.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the Claude panel staying blank after the editor cached an incomplete copy of its files; it now recovers by itself, or says what went wrong and how to fix it
[VSCode] Fixed long slash-command messages such as `/goal` filling the chat panel; they now fold behind Show more like other prompts (anthropics/claude-code#97469)
[VSCode] Fixed long messages not folding behind Show more after the chat panel is made narrower
[VSCode] Fixed a mod's "From the … plugin" label above the prompt being drawn over the slash command and @-mention menus (anthropics/claude-code#102981)
[VSCode] Fixed an empty list item, paragraph or code block, and list items renumbered from 1, when pasting copied LaTeX math

title.zh-TW: VS Code 編輯等待時間縮短，憑證警告提示與空紀錄修復
title.en: VS Code Edit Wait Time Shortened, Certificate Warning Guidance and Empty Logs Fixed

body.zh-TW: 當你在 VS Code 中編修程式碼或發出語音指令時，操作延遲與背景紀錄邏輯獲得了調整。聽寫或套件自身請求的憑證（確認連線對象身分的證明）驗證失敗時，例如經過會檢查加密流量的代理伺服器，日誌現在會提供處理指引。每次開啟新對話卻未發送訊息時，歷史紀錄不再被空工作階段塞滿。若在 `~/.claude/keybindings.json` 的 Chat 區段將 `"ctrl+j"` 設為 `null`，在聊天輸入框按下 Ctrl+J 不再強制換行，改交由 VS Code 與作業系統處理。當組織不接受意見回饋時，錯誤提示不再只回傳 HTTP 狀態碼，會顯示具體原因。聊天面板中的編輯與寫入速度加快，每次編輯後等待偵測新問題的時間從原本的 1 至 1.5 秒縮短為多數情況下的 0.75 秒。
body.en: When editing code or issuing voice commands in VS Code, operational latency and background logging logic have been adjusted. When certificate verification (checking digital proof of the connection target's identity) fails for dictation or extension requests, such as when passing through a proxy that inspects encrypted traffic, logs now provide troubleshooting guidance. Opening a new conversation without sending a message no longer clutters history with empty sessions. If `"ctrl+j"` is set to `null` in the Chat section of `~/.claude/keybindings.json`, pressing Ctrl+J in the chat input box no longer forces a newline, deferring handling to VS Code and the operating system. When an organization does not accept feedback, error prompts no longer return only an HTTP status code, displaying the specific reason instead. Editing and writing in the chat panel are faster, reducing the wait time to detect new problems after each edit from 1 to 1.5 seconds down to 0.75 seconds in most cases.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a log warning that says what to do when dictation or the extension's own requests fail certificate verification, such as behind a TLS-inspecting proxy
[VSCode] Fixed Session history filling up with empty "Untitled" sessions each time you start a new session without sending a message
[VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+J in the chat input always inserting a newline: it is now left to VS Code and the OS when "ctrl+j" is set to null in the Chat context of ~/.claude/keybindings.json
[VSCode] Fixed the feedback error showing only an HTTP status when your organization does not accept feedback
[VSCode] Improved Edit and Write speed in the chat panel: the wait for new problems after each edit is now 0.75 seconds in most cases, down from 1 to 1.5 seconds

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段修正環境變數引號，管理介面與變更清單明朗化
title.en: Cloud Sessions Fix Environment Variable Quotes, Admin Interface and Changes List Clarified

body.zh-TW: 當你在瀏覽器管理雲端工作階段與連線設定時，表單填寫與文件顯示體驗有了改善。在例行表單中新增連接器時，清單在載入期間不再誤報沒有可用的連接器。雲端環境編輯器不再打亂變數順序，當數值同時包含單引號與雙引號時，也不會再多餘地自動補上反斜線。管理設定中的自架環境對話框獲得調整，標題、分頁標籤與按鈕在滾動時會固定在可視範圍，只有中間內容會捲動。雲端工作階段中的閱讀文件工具列不再顯示跳脫後的 JSON 原始碼，而是會呈現易讀的排版內容。變更面板現在會主動標明目前是僅列出已推送的提交，還是僅顯示 Claude 的檔案修改。
body.en: When managing cloud sessions and connection settings in the browser, the experience for filling out forms and viewing documents has improved. When adding connectors in routine forms, the list no longer falsely claims that no connectors are available while loading. The cloud environment editor no longer scrambles variable order, nor does it insert redundant backslashes when values contain both single and double quotes. The self-hosted environment dialog in administrative settings has been adjusted so that headers, tabs, and buttons stay pinned in view while scrolling, leaving only the middle content scrollable. The document-reading toolbar in cloud sessions no longer displays escaped raw JSON, rendering cleanly formatted content instead. The changes panel now explicitly clarifies whether it is listing only pushed commits or displaying only file modifications made by Claude.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the Add connector list in routine forms saying no connectors were available while they were still loading
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the cloud environment editor shuffling environment variables and adding backslashes to values that contain both kinds of quote
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the self-hosted environment details dialog in admin settings so its title, tabs and buttons stay in view while only the content scrolls
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the "read documentation" tool row in cloud sessions, which showed escaped JSON instead of a readable page
[Cloud sessions] Improved a cloud session's Changes pane, which now says when it lists only pushed commits or only Claude's edits

title.zh-TW: Slack 標註草稿正確轉發頻道，審核按鈕支援重啟對話
title.en: Slack Channel Drafts Dispatch Correctly, Review Buttons Support Restarting Sessions

body.zh-TW: 當你的團隊在 Slack 頻道中使用 Claude 進行協作時，訊息派送與互動卡片的穩定性顯著提升。你在頻道中核准的草稿，以前可能被 Claude 誤貼到私訊中；現在沒有指明頻道的貼文會被直接拒絕，確保內容確實發布至指定的頻道。在審核卡片上按下核准或拒絕時，若背後的工作階段已經停止，你的操作現在會自動重啟該工作階段繼續執行。在工作區轉移至不同 Claude 組織後（包括 Enterprise Grid 上的未共用頻道），Claude 不會再漏看頻道中未被標註的討論訊息。在對討論串發布回覆之前，Claude 現在會先讀取其他人剛發送的最新留言，避免發言內容脫節。管理後台的 Slack 設定頁面若載入失敗，不再誤報尚未連接工作區，而是會顯示錯誤訊息並提供重試按鈕。
body.en: When your team collaborates with Claude inside Slack channels, the reliability of message dispatching and interactive cards has significantly improved. Drafts approved in a channel were previously at risk of being mistakenly posted by Claude into direct messages. Posts without a specified channel are now rejected outright, ensuring content is delivered to the designated channel. When clicking approve or reject on a review card, if the underlying session has stopped, your action now automatically restarts that session to proceed. After workspaces are migrated to a different Claude organization (including unshared channels on Enterprise Grid), Claude no longer misses unmentioned discussion messages in channels. Before posting replies to a thread, Claude now reads the latest comments just posted by others, preventing disjointed responses. If the admin Slack settings page fails to load, it no longer falsely reports that no workspace is connected, instead displaying an error message alongside a retry button.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack posting a draft you approved for a channel into your DM by mistake; a post with no channel is now refused so it can go to the approved channel
[Claude Tag] Fixed Allow and Deny on Claude's approval cards in Slack doing nothing when the session had stopped; your answer now restarts the session
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude ignoring untagged messages in a Slack channel after its workspace moved to a different Claude organization, including unshared channels on Enterprise Grid
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in a Slack channel posting a threaded reply before reading a newer message someone had just added to that thread
[Claude Tag] Fixed the Slack page in Claude Tag admin settings saying no workspaces were connected when the list failed to load; it now shows an error with a Retry button

title.zh-TW: PR 審查檢查標記自動補全，手動停止審查及時關閉檢查
title.en: Pull Request Review Check Marks Automatically Backfilled, Manual Stops Promptly Close Checks

body.zh-TW: 當你在 GitHub Pull Request 上等待自動程式碼審查時，檢查狀態更新結果現在更為準確。當審查已經順利完成，但先前建立檢查狀態的嘗試曾失敗過，工具在最終重試時現在會確實補上已完成的檢查標記，不再讓 PR 懸空呈現沒有檢查結果的狀態。若在審查執行期間推播了新的程式碼並在後方排隊，即使輸入了 `@claude review stop` 手動停止，以往排隊的審查仍會被啟動；現在排隊的檢查會立即關閉，並具體註明被停止的原因。⟦如同公文簽核系統在審批完畢後自動蓋上最終核准章，中途撤回的案件也會立刻標記撤回原因，避免審核進度懸而未決。⟧
body.en: When waiting for automated code reviews on GitHub pull requests, check status updates are now more accurate. When a review finishes successfully but earlier attempts to create the check status failed, the tool on its final retry now reliably backfills the completed check mark, preventing the pull request from hanging in a state with no check results. If new code is pushed during an ongoing review and queued up behind it, typing `@claude review stop` to halt the review manually previously still allowed queued reviews to start. Queued checks are now closed immediately with the specific cancellation reason noted. ⟦Just as an official document approval system automatically applies a final approval stamp once sign-off is complete, any case recalled midway is immediately marked with the withdrawal reason to prevent review progress from remaining in limbo.⟧

items.original:
[Code Review] Fixed a finished review showing no check on the pull request when earlier tries to create it failed; a final try now adds a completed check
[Code Review] Fixed a push queued behind a running review still starting a review after `@claude review stop`; its check now closes and says why

title.zh-TW: Code Review 支援停止指令，快速解除 PR 自動審查
title.en: Code Review adds stop commands to end automatic PR reviews

body.zh-TW: 當你在 GitHub 的拉取請求（Pull Request）啟用自動審查後，若是功能已經測試完畢準備合併，往往不需要機器人再次介入。⟦跟退訂每日鮮乳配送一樣，以前聯絡客服終止可能還會多送一天的牛奶，現在辦理完成立即停送，不會在退訂當天又往門口放一瓶多餘的飲品。⟧現在 Code Review 新增了 `@claude review stop` 指令，同時也支援 `@claude review off` 與 `@claude review pause`。輸入後能直接結束該拉取請求上的 `@claude review always` 訂閱，而且不會觸發新一輪審查。在合併程式碼的最後關頭，你可以俐落收尾，不必再被多餘的審查留言打擾。
body.en: After you enable automatic reviews on a GitHub pull request, you often do not need the bot to step in again once the feature has been tested and is ready to merge. ⟦Canceling a daily milk delivery used to mean contacting customer service and possibly receiving milk for another day. Now deliveries stop as soon as the cancellation is processed, without an extra bottle arriving at your door that day.⟧ Code Review now supports `@claude review stop`, along with `@claude review off` and `@claude review pause`. These commands directly end the `@claude review always` subscription for that pull request without triggering another review. As you prepare to merge the code, you can wrap things up without extra review comments getting in the way.

items.original: [Code Review] Added `@claude review stop` (also `off` and `pause`) to Code Review, ending an `@claude review always` subscription on a pull request without starting a new review

title.zh-TW: 內建指令選單顯示精簡描述，新增 API 版本切換
title.en: Built-in command menus show shorter descriptions and add API version switching

body.zh-TW: 平常在終端機按下 `/` 或是輸入 `/help` 查詢功能時，畫面呈現的整潔度直接影響尋找指令的效率。以前針對 `/claude-api` 等內建技能，清單會直接倒出寫給模型閱讀的長篇說明，把選單畫面撐得相當冗長。⟦讀者翻閱工具書的索引目錄時，以前條目旁印滿給排版校對看的長篇備註，現在全部換回簡短摘要，版面呈現乾淨明瞭。⟧現在選單已改為顯示給使用者看的精簡說明，閱讀起來不再雜亂。若你需要將專案內的 Claude API 程式碼推進至 `2026-10-21` 版本，直接輸入 `/claude-api api-version` 即可快速遷移。
body.en: When you press `/` in the terminal or enter `/help` to look up features, a tidy display directly affects how quickly you can find a command. For built-in skills such as `/claude-api`, the list previously displayed lengthy instructions written for the model, making the menu cumbersome. ⟦When readers browsed a reference book's index, entries used to be crowded with long notes intended for typesetters and proofreaders. Those notes have now been replaced with short summaries, leaving the layout clear and easy to read.⟧ The menu now shows concise descriptions written for users, making it easier to read. If you need to migrate your project's Claude API code to version `2026-10-21`, enter `/claude-api api-version` to make the switch quickly.

items.original:

Fixed `/help` and the `/` command menu showing long model-facing descriptions for bundled skills such as `/claude-api` instead of their short descriptions

title.zh-TW: 安全事件支援遙測追蹤，權限清單清楚列出被拒指令
title.en: Safety events gain telemetry tracking, and permission lists identify denied commands

body.zh-TW: 當你透過自動模式或安全規則控管各項工具時，操作被擋下的細節與放行流程現在更加清楚。只要工具呼叫被權限規則、自動模式、安全檢查、掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）或沙盒阻止、提示或退回，OpenTelemetry 都會記錄 `claude_code.safety_event` 遙測事件。以前在 `/permissions` 的 Recently denied 畫面中不會顯示被拒絕的 shell 指令，且自動模式的本機分類器在審查重試指令時還會忽略此處的核准；現在核准記錄會直接標明具體指令名稱而非抽象描述。當網頁搜尋預算耗盡時，通知也會同步告誡 Claude 不得透過瀏覽器或電腦操作（computer use）轉向外部搜尋引擎查詢。以前指令被擋下後難以追查原貌、核准重試又可能再次受阻，現在每一道安全關卡都有跡可循，放行指令也能正確生效。
body.en: When you control tools through auto mode or safety rules, the details of blocked actions and the approval process are now clearer. Whenever permission rules, auto mode, safety checks, hooks (small programs triggered by specific events), or the sandbox block a tool call, prompt for approval, or send it back, OpenTelemetry records a `claude_code.safety_event` telemetry event. Previously, the Recently denied view in `/permissions` did not show denied shell commands, and auto mode's local classifier ignored approvals made there when reviewing retried commands. Approval records now identify the specific command rather than giving an abstract description. When the web search budget runs out, the notification also tells Claude not to turn to external search engines through the browser or computer use (operating a computer's interface). Previously, it was difficult to trace the original command after it was blocked, and an approved retry could be blocked again. Now each safety check leaves a record, and command approvals take effect correctly.

items.original:
Added the `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry event for each tool call a permission rule, auto mode, a safety check, a hook or the sandbox stopped, prompted or sent back
Fixed `/permissions` > Recently denied not showing the denied shell command, and auto mode's local classifier ignoring an approval from there when it checks a retried command; approving a row now names the command, not its description
Changed the notice Claude gets when the WebSearch budget is used up to also tell it not to query search engines in a browser or through computer use

title.zh-TW: 修復 MCP 工具連線與休眠逾時，避免重複發送寫入請求
title.en: MCP connection and sleep timeout fixes prevent duplicate write requests

body.zh-TW: 當你依賴 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）擴充功能時，以下連線問題已修好。在 macOS 上，若登入鑰匙圈鎖定，`claude -p` 會說明驗證受阻的原因，解鎖後下次執行便能連線，無須重新登入。過去 macOS 或 Linux 電腦在 MCP 伺服器連線途中進入睡眠，伺服器會被回報為逾時，並在無頭模式（沒有視覺介面的執行模式）下一直顯示失敗，這已修好。HTTP 呼叫中途斷線時，現在僅限唯讀或具備冪等特性（重做也不改變結果）的工具才會自動重試，避免寫入操作觸發兩次。背景任務執行時，新一輪對話有時未取得 SDK MCP 伺服器的最新工具，這已修好。桌面版 Code 標籤頁中，直接設定的 GitHub MCP 伺服器寫入工具，表單關閉後未建立內容的狀況也已修正。
body.en: If you rely on MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) for added functionality, the following connection problems have been fixed. On macOS, if the login keychain is locked, `claude -p` explains why authentication is blocked. After unlocking it, the next run can connect without requiring you to log in again. Previously, if a macOS or Linux computer went to sleep while connecting to an MCP server, the server was reported as timed out and continued to appear failed in headless mode (running without a visual interface). This has been fixed. If an HTTP call loses its connection midway, automatic retries are now limited to tools that are read-only or idempotent (repeating the operation does not change the result), preventing writes from being triggered twice. A new conversation turn sometimes failed to get the latest tools from SDK MCP servers while background tasks were running; this has been fixed. In the desktop app's Code tab, write tools from directly configured GitHub MCP servers showed a form that closed without creating anything. This has also been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed MCP servers showing "needs authentication" in `claude -p` on macOS while the login keychain was locked; they now say why, and the next run after an unlock connects without a new sign-in
Fixed MCP servers being reported as timed out, and staying failed in headless runs, when a macOS or Linux computer went to sleep while they were connecting
Fixed HTTP MCP tool calls being sent twice when the connection closed mid-call; only read-only or idempotent tools are now retried
Fixed a turn sometimes starting without an SDK MCP server's latest tools when a background task was running
Fixed write tools on a directly configured GitHub MCP server showing a form that closed without creating anything in the desktop app's Code tab

title.zh-TW: 子代理避免重複接工，工具呼叫格式錯誤時支援自動重試
title.en: Subagents avoid duplicate assignments, and malformed tool calls can retry automatically

body.zh-TW: 當你借助子代理或 Agent SDK 執行複雜的多工流程時，多項非同步協作的容錯機制已完成補強。針對同時啟動的多個 fork 子代理，現在各自分發時會明確指派身分，不再容易互相搶接對方的工作。⟦工廠領班指派多人協同組裝時，以前組員容易爭搶同一份工單，現在每個人都清楚領取專屬工作卡，遇到辨識不清的指示還會主動重新確認，最多兩次。⟧工具呼叫無法解析時，現在最多重試兩次；仍無法解析才會報錯並結束這一輪。在文字稿記錄方面，串流回應不再填入佔位的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數值與空白停止原因；透過 SDK 的 `setModel()` 切換模型時，確認等待時間也由 5 秒放寬至 15 秒。這些調整減少了自動化流程中的非預期中斷，讓複雜排程執行得更平穩。
body.en: If you use subagents or the Agent SDK for complex multitasking workflows, several safeguards for asynchronous collaboration have been strengthened. Multiple fork subagents launched at the same time now receive explicit identities when dispatched, making them less likely to take each other's assignments. ⟦When a factory foreman assigned several workers to assemble something together, workers used to compete for the same work order. Now each worker clearly receives a dedicated job card and actively asks for clarification when instructions are unclear, up to two times.⟧ Tool calls that cannot be parsed now retry up to two times. An error is reported and the turn ends only if parsing still fails. In transcripts, streaming responses no longer include placeholder token (a unit of text AI processes and bills for) counts or empty stop reasons. When switching models through the SDK's `setModel()`, the wait for confirmation has also been extended from 5 seconds to 15 seconds. These changes reduce unexpected interruptions in automated workflows and help complex schedules run more smoothly.

items.original:
Fixed subagent transcripts recording placeholder token usage and an empty stop reason for streamed responses
Fixed model switches through the Agent SDK's `setModel()`, and apps built on it, being refused when the API took more than 5 seconds to confirm the model; Claude Code now waits up to 15 seconds
Improved recovery from unparseable tool calls: Claude Code now retries the call up to twice before ending the turn with an error
Improved fork subagents launched together: each is now told which launch is its own, so forks are much less likely to try to start each other's work

title.zh-TW: 修正自訂閘道標頭與遙測錯誤，完善模型設定判定
title.en: Custom gateway header and telemetry fixes improve model setting handling

body.zh-TW: 若你使用自訂 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 閘道（代為轉送連線請求的中間服務）或 Foundry，無效的 prompt-caching-scope 標頭已不再送出。Claude apps 閘道工作階段不再忽略 CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS；其 Claude Desktop 工作階段設定 OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS 後遙測遭拒的問題已修復。CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT 搭配帶 [1m] 的模型別名時不再報錯找不到模型。Artifact 讀取重用連線遭伺服器關閉時不再出現連線重設錯誤。自 2.1.305 起，axScreenReader 與 env 區塊中的 CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER，只從使用者、受管理或 --settings 生效。
body.en: If you use a custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL gateway (an intermediary service that forwards connection requests) or Foundry, the invalid prompt-caching-scope header is no longer sent. Claude apps gateway sessions no longer ignore CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS. Telemetry rejection after setting OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS in their Claude Desktop sessions has been fixed. Using CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT with a model alias containing [1m] no longer produces a model-not-found error. Artifact reads no longer produce connection reset errors when the server has closed a reused connection. Starting with 2.1.305, axScreenReader and CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER in the env block take effect only from user settings, managed settings, or --settings.

Fixed `CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS` being ignored in Claude apps gateway sessions

title.zh-TW: 瀏覽器登入即刻顯示成功頁面，加快遠端與雲端連線速度
title.en: Browser sign-in shows success immediately, and remote and cloud connections are faster

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟瀏覽器登入帳號或使用遠端連線功能時，整體等待體驗與狀態回報已獲得多項改進。現在瀏覽器登入只要一完成，瀏覽器便會立刻跳出成功畫面，不需要乾等帳號個人資料慢慢載入。桌面應用有某個 MCP 外部工具伺服器連不上時，雲端工作階段等待首次回覆的時間也縮短了。如果對話文字稿中塞滿了貼上的大型圖片或 PDF 讀取內容，遠端控制（Remote Control）的連線建立過程也變得更快。透過桌面應用程式封存閒置工作階段而中止的背景指令，通知會清楚標明輸出檔案名稱，不再向 Claude 誤報成是使用者手動停止。
body.en: When you sign in through a browser or use remote connections, several changes improve waiting times and status reporting. As soon as browser sign-in finishes, the browser now immediately shows a success page without waiting for account profile data to load. In cloud sessions, the wait for the first response is shorter when one of the desktop app's MCP servers can't connect. Remote Control connections also start faster when the conversation transcript contains large pasted images or PDF content that has been read. When archiving an idle session through the desktop app stops a background command, the notification clearly identifies the output filename and no longer incorrectly tells Claude that the user stopped it manually.

items.original:
Fixed a background command stopped through a connected app (such as the desktop app archiving an idle session) being reported to Claude as stopped by the user; the notice now names its output file
Improved browser sign-in: the success page now appears as soon as sign-in completes, without waiting for your account profile to load
Improved the time to the first reply in cloud sessions when one of the desktop app's MCP servers can't connect
Improved Remote Control connect time for sessions whose transcript contains large pasted images or PDF reads

title.zh-TW: 修正對話自動精簡震盪，避免重啟後舊訊息復活
title.en: Fixes reduce autocompaction thrashing and keep cleared messages from returning after restarts

body.zh-TW: 長時間對話並夾帶大量圖表資料時，歷史訊息的壓縮與清理機制決定了對話能否順利延續。⟦辦公室碎紙機處理厚重的設計圖冊時，以前一次塞入太多大張圖紙容易反覆卡紙倒退，清空後的廢紙匣在重開電源後竟然還會把舊草稿吐出來；現在卡紙少了一些，清空的廢紙匣也不會再吐出舊草稿。⟧過去在單一輪次中讀取大量 PDF 頁面、圖片或龐大工具輸出時，可能出現「Autocompact is thrashing」錯誤，代表自動精簡反覆震盪；這次修好了其中一部分情況。在雲端工作階段中，自訂的 `/autocompact` 視窗範圍在工作階段重新啟動後不會再跳回預設值。透過 `/clear` 清除的對話紀錄，在雲端或自託管執行器重啟後，也不會再莫名其妙復活。
body.en: In long conversations with lots of charts and other data, the way message history is compressed and cleared determines whether the conversation can continue smoothly. ⟦When an office shredder handled a thick book of design drawings, feeding in too many large sheets used to make it repeatedly jam and reverse. Even an emptied waste bin would spit out old drafts after the power was turned back on. Now there are fewer jams, and an emptied bin no longer spits out old drafts.⟧ Previously, reading many PDF pages, images, or large tool outputs in a single turn could cause an “Autocompact is thrashing” error, meaning automatic compaction was repeatedly oscillating. Some of these cases have been fixed. In cloud sessions, a custom `/autocompact` window range no longer resets to its default after the session restarts. Conversation history cleared with `/clear` also no longer unexpectedly returns after a cloud or self-hosted runner restarts.

items.original:
Fixed some "Autocompact is thrashing" errors in turns that read many PDF pages, images or other large tool results
Fixed `/autocompact` in cloud sessions going back to the default window after the session restarted
Fixed a conversation cleared with `/clear` sometimes coming back when a cloud or self-hosted runner session restarted

title.zh-TW: 雲端搜尋提供即時進度回饋，網頁讀取錯誤回歸正常結果
title.en: Cloud search shows live progress, and web fetch failures return normal results

body.zh-TW: 當你在雲端環境挑選儲存庫或讓 Claude 抓取網頁資料時，多處介面狀態與錯誤回饋現在更為貼近真實情況。在儲存庫選擇器中，搜尋進行中會明確顯示「Searching…」，不會再於結果抵達前誤跳「找不到相符儲存庫」的假警報。面對自託管環境，「Waiting for a runner」的等待提示不再被截斷，若是隨選執行器，還會從你最後一則訊息起算等待秒數，並顯示失敗次數。在網路擷取方面，Cowork 雲端工作階段的 WebFetch 遇到網站回傳 4xx 狀態碼或 robots.txt 阻擋時，會如同本機環境般作為一般結果呈現，不再拋出工具錯誤。在雲端或自託管執行器工作階段，搜尋遭 403 拒絕且回應附有原因時，現在會顯示該原因，不再只顯示驗證錯誤（Authentication error）。
body.en: When you select a repository in the cloud or have Claude fetch web content, several interface states and error messages now more accurately reflect what is happening. The repository picker explicitly shows “Searching…” while a search is running, instead of prematurely showing a false “No repositories match” message before results arrive. In self-hosted environments, the “Waiting for a runner” message is no longer cut off. For on-demand runners, it also shows the seconds spent waiting since your last message and the number of failures. For web fetching, when a website returns a 4xx status code or robots.txt blocks access, WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions now presents this as a normal result, as it does locally, instead of raising a tool error. In cloud or self-hosted runner sessions, when a search is denied with a 403 response that includes a reason, that reason is now shown instead of just “Authentication error”.

items.original:
Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions reporting a tool error when a site answered with a 4xx status or a robots.txt refusal; it is now a normal result, as in local sessions
Improved web search errors in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions: a search refused with a 403 that gives a reason now shows that reason instead of a generic "Authentication error"
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the repository picker saying "No repositories match" while a search was still running; it now shows "Searching…" until the results arrive
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the "Waiting for a runner" status on self-hosted environments being cut off; with on-demand runners it now counts up from your last message and shows failed attempts

title.zh-TW: 自託管執行器預設掛鉤超時上限，防止殘留程序佔用槽位
title.en: Self-hosted runners add a default hook timeout and prevent leftover processes from occupying slots

body.zh-TW: 自行架設執行器（Self-hosted runner）跑自動化流程的人，這版要留意四項改動。專案準備階段的 checkout 掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）現在預設以 30 分鐘為限，超時會直接判定設定失敗；若任務需要更久，可自訂 `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` 延長時間或設為 `0` 解除上限。過去若在掛鉤執行期間封存或重新排入工作階段，或停止執行器，掛鉤的行程會留著繼續執行，執行器的槽位也一直被佔住，這已修好。啟用 `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` 時，也不會再誤將前一次工作階段留下的 `.claude/settings.local.json` 提交進版本控制中。替 Anthropic 管理的 Git 建立憑證檔案時，現在比照 CLI 過濾受信任憑證，並以 `[runner:warn]` 記錄排除數量。
body.en: If you run automation on a self-hosted runner, there are four changes to note in this release. Checkout hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) during project preparation now have a default limit of 30 minutes, after which setup is marked as failed. If a task needs longer, use `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` to extend the limit or set it to `0` to remove the limit. Previously, archiving or requeuing a session while a hook was running, or stopping the runner, left the hook's process running and kept the runner's slot occupied. This has been fixed. With `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` enabled, `.claude/settings.local.json` left over from a previous session is also no longer mistakenly committed to version control. When creating certificate files for Anthropic-managed Git, the runner now filters trusted certificates the same way as the CLI and logs the number excluded with `[runner:warn]`.

items.original:
Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` committing a `.claude/settings.local.json` left in the clone by an earlier session
Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session, or stopping the runner, during its checkout hook leaving the hook's processes running and the runner's slot held
Self-hosted runner: Changed checkout hooks to be stopped after 30 minutes by default, failing the session's setup; if yours needs longer, raise `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` or set it to `0`
Self-hosted runner: Changed the certificate file built for Anthropic-managed git to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does; a `[runner:warn]` line gives the number left out

title.zh-TW: VS Code 限制展開提示詞高度，修正 LaTeX 數學式貼上格式
title.en: VS Code limits expanded prompt height and fixes pasted LaTeX formatting

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 中使用 Claude Code 撰寫複雜指示或整理筆記時，對話框排版與文字貼上體驗更為順暢。過去只要點擊 Show more 展開較長的提示詞，整張輸入卡片會直接霸佔整個對話面板；現在釘選的提示詞高度被限制在面板的 40% 以內，超出範圍時會自動產生捲軸方便上下滾動。當你複製含有 LaTeX 數學式的清單項目或表格儲存格時，貼進富文字編輯器中不會再被錯誤切碎成全新的清單或表格。遇到擴充套件重啟後殘留的 Claude 背景行程時，「仍在其他地方開啟」的提示視窗現在也能清楚識別，並說明該行程通常在約 10 分鐘內便會自行退出。以前長文字一展開就遮蔽對話歷史、貼上公式格式又容易碎裂，現在排版邊界更穩定，編輯與查閱操作不再互相打架。
body.en: Writing complex instructions or organizing notes with Claude Code in VS Code now feels smoother, with better conversation layouts and text pasting. Previously, clicking Show more to expand a long prompt made the entire input card take over the conversation panel. Pinned prompts are now limited to 40% of the panel’s height, with a scrollbar appearing automatically when the content exceeds that limit. When you copy list items or table cells containing LaTeX equations into a rich text editor, they no longer get incorrectly split into new lists or tables. The “still open somewhere else” notice now clearly identifies Claude background processes left over after an extension restart and explains that they usually exit on their own within about 10 minutes. Previously, expanding long text obscured the conversation history, and pasting equations could break their formatting. With more stable layout boundaries, editing and reviewing no longer get in each other’s way.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed a long prompt expanded with Show more covering the whole chat panel: a pinned prompt is now capped at 40% of the panel and scrolls
[VSCode] Fixed part of a list item or table cell with LaTeX math pasting as a new list or table in rich text editors
[VSCode] Changed the "still open somewhere else" notice to also cover a Claude process left over from an extension restart, which usually ends on its own within about 10 minutes

title.zh-TW: VS Code 語音聽寫新增中斷提示，完善 TLS 憑證支援
title.en: VS Code voice dictation adds stop explanations and improves TLS certificate support

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 裡對著麥克風念出程式碼需求時，自動停止的機制與公司內網憑證相容性已經獲得完善。當語音聽寫因連續 15 秒沒有辨識出語音或達到 2 分鐘上限而自動關閉時，麥克風按鈕會跳出說明告知原因，並確認剛才說過的文字皆已妥善保留。針對經 TLS 封包檢查的代理網路，若僅在 `~/.claude/settings.json` 設定 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 曾導致聽寫連線失敗，現在已修好，聽寫也會遵循 `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`。語音聽寫與擴充套件本身的請求，現在都比照 CLI 過濾受信任憑證。擴充套件本身的請求也會信任環境變數或使用者設定指定的 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 憑證檔案。
body.en: When you dictate coding requirements into a microphone in VS Code, automatic stopping and compatibility with corporate network certificates now work more reliably. If voice dictation stops automatically after 15 consecutive seconds without recognized speech or upon reaching the 2-minute limit, the microphone button displays an explanation and confirms that everything you dictated has been preserved. On proxy networks with TLS inspection, setting `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` only in `~/.claude/settings.json` could cause dictation connections to fail. This is now fixed, and dictation also follows `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`. Voice dictation and the extension’s own requests now filter trusted certificates the same way the CLI does. The extension’s own requests also trust the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` certificate file specified through environment variables or user settings.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a notice on the microphone button when voice dictation stops by itself (15 seconds without recognized speech, or the 2-minute limit), saying why and that the text so far is kept
[VSCode] Fixed dictation failing behind a TLS-inspecting proxy when `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` is set only in `~/.claude/settings.json`; it now also follows `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`
[VSCode] Changed voice dictation to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does
[VSCode] Changed the extension's own requests to filter their trusted certificates as the CLI does, and to trust the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` file named in the environment or in user settings

entries: Fixed `claude -p` inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables
Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段裡的 `claude -p` 不再誤報沒登入
title.en: `claude -p` in cloud sessions no longer falsely reports "Not logged in"

body.zh-TW: 明明登入好了，腳本卻回你「Not logged in」，很容易讓人摸不著頭緒。這發生在雲端工作階段裡另外執行 `claude -p`（不開互動畫面、直接回一次答案）時：只要沒帶上該工作階段的環境變數，就會這樣誤報。現在不會了。
body.en: Running `claude -p` (which answers once without opening the interactive screen) inside a cloud session without that session's environment variables used to report "Not logged in", as if you had never signed in. It no longer does.

items.original: Fixed `claude -p` inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables

title.zh-TW: 接很多 MCP 工具時，API 錯誤不再被誤報成對話太長
title.en: With many MCP tools, API errors are no longer mislabeled as "prompt is too long"

body.zh-TW: 明明才聊幾句，畫面卻說「prompt is too long」，你可能以為得開新對話了。這發生在接了很多 MCP 工具（讓 Claude 連外部服務的擴充）的工作階段：碰到 API 錯誤時，錯誤訊息會被換成這句。它還會順手做一次不必要的 compaction（把舊對話濃縮成摘要）。現在你看到的是原本的 API 錯誤，對話也不會白白被壓縮。
body.en: In sessions with many MCP tools (extensions that connect Claude to outside services), an API error used to show up as "prompt is too long", making you think the conversation had grown too long. It also triggered an unneeded compaction (condensing older conversation into a summary). Now you see the original API error, and your conversation is not compacted for nothing.

items.original: Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools
